column3: Picks the best player of the month ratings with the requested age and records him as the month winner, with his club. `MONTH_AWARD::award_best_rated_player(notes, age)`, called at the turn of the month by the nations' awards (England's at 0x579a37..0x579adc). It takes the best of the ratings (`exe::month_ratings_find_best_player`) in the award's league (`[+9]`, or −1) and with the requested age; when one is found, it records the winner (`exe::month_award_set_winner`) with the person's club (`staff::CLUB_JOB`, or −1), and the month (`month_ratings_fields::MONTH`) and year (`month_ratings_fields::YEAR`) of the ratings. The high bytes of the month and the year are passed exactly as the original pushes them (taken from the person table, `G_STAFF_TABLE`, in the register).

Finds the month slot, stores the person and the club, raises the winner's reputation, sends the news and records the award in the history. `MONTH_AWARD::set_winner(id, club_id, month, year)`. It looks for the month's slot (12 slots of 11 bytes: month at `month_award_fields::SLOT_MONTH`, year at `month_award_fields::SLOT_YEAR`); without one, it does nothing. It stores the person (`month_award_fields::SLOT_WINNER_ID`) and the club (`month_award_fields::SLOT_CLUB_ID`); when there is a person, it raises the award winner's reputation (`raise_winner_reputation`, with the award's reputations `award_fields::NATIONAL_REPUTATION` and `award_fields::WORLD_REPUTATION` and the player flag `award_fields::FOR_PLAYERS`); then the news (`exe::month_award_post_winner_news`) and the award record (`exe::staff_records_add_month_award_record` on `G_STAFF_RECORDS`, with the award's +5).

Creates the fixture of a tie (or only marks it as deferred): competition, round, rules, clubs, date (tomorrow if already past), slot, stadium and calendar; the news to human managers; in a two-legged round, the second leg `cup_round::LEG_GAP_DAYS` days later with home and away swapped. Convention: thiscall, ret `0xc`, `Cup.cpp`, SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path (the local dates and news item). `create_tie_fixtures(round, tie, adiar)` (`adiar`: defer), called from the round set-up (`0x51c800`) and from the competition screen. Tie −1: the first tie of the round with `cup_tie::FIXTURE_STATE` = 1 (defer) or 2 (create); none: 0. Defer: flag 2. Create: flag 3; with a team missing (`+0`/`cup_tie::AWAY_TEAM` = −1), the news of the pending tie (`exe::cup_post_draw_news`: push tie; push round; mov ecx, esi -> thiscall, ret 8). Otherwise the fixture is built in a local of `0x4f` bytes: the competition (`set_competition`) and the id (`+0`, −1 if none), −1 at `set_match_stats_slot`, the cup year (`year()`) at `set_season_year`, `stage_label()` at `set_round_prefix`; from the round (`0x68` bytes at `+0xa3`) the code `cup_round::ROUND_CODE` (`+3` in a two-legged round, `cup_round::LEGS` = 2) at `set_round_name`, `cup_round::ROUND_NUMBER` at `set_round_number`, `cup_round::DRAW_RULES` at `set_round_draw_rules`, the rules `cup_round::TIE_RULES` at `set_tie_rules` (with no second leg and with `0x800`: `0x1000` if the level (`+4` of the team) of the home team is not lower than the away team's, otherwise `0x800`), `cup_round::MATCH_CATEGORY` at `set_category`; the league (`stage_index()`) at `set_stage_index`, the flags (`0xff`, 1, 0), the cup's virtual `comp_vtable::SET_FIXTURE_SUBSTITUTES` (push &fixture; mov ecx, esi), bit `0x400` of `+0x4d` (no second leg and `cup_round::SINGLE_LEG_FLAG` > 0), the clubs (`set_home_club`, `set_away_club`) and ids (`set_home_club_id`, `set_away_club_id`; −1 with no club), the date (day `cup_round::DAY`, year `cup_round::YEAR_OFFSET` + the cup's), the slot `cup_round::TIME_SLICE`, the date of the next round (`cup_round::DAY + 0x68`/`cup_round::YEAR_OFFSET + 0x68`; 0 in the last one), the stadium (`FN_STADIUM_SET_FIXTURE_VENUE`: push `venue_stadium_id()` of the cup; push &fixture; push `cup_round::VENUE_VALUE`; mov ecx, `G_STADIUM` -> thiscall, ret `0xc`) and the calendar (add_fixture_to_calendar). With a human manager at either club and without `tie_rules::FIXED_DATES` in `cup_round::TIE_RULES`, news item `0x14` goes to both. In a two-legged round, with the cup still in `G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE`: the second leg `cup_round::LEG_GAP_DAYS` days later (`exe::new_date`, `exe::date_add_days`, `exe::date_operator_3d`), code `+4`, the slot by the day of the week (`FN_DATE_GET_WEEKDAY`: Saturday or Sunday 1, otherwise 2), home and away swapped, the stadium and the calendar. Returns 1.

Posts news item `0x26` for a tie with an undecided team: the cup, the round and the possible teams, to the managers of each club. Convention: thiscall, ret 8, `Cup.cpp`, SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path (the local news item). `post_draw_news(round, tie)`, called only from `0x51cb90`. With both teams decided, or a round (`0x68` bytes at `+0xa3`) with fewer than 2 ties (`cup_round::TIES`): nothing. Each side with no team (`+0`/`away_team()` = −1) comes from its source tie (round `home_link_round()`/`away_link_round()`, tie `home_link_tie()`/`away_link_tie()`; with no source or with a team missing there: nothing): the two possible clubs; with a team, its club (`+0xa7`, 6 bytes). News item `0x26`: 0 = the cup id, 1 = `stage_label()`, 2 = the round code (`+7`), 3/4 = the home team and −1 or the two possible ones, 5/6 = the away team and −1 or the two possible ones; sent to the managers of each of its clubs (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`: push club; push &news; mov ecx, `G_NEWS` -> thiscall, ret 8; the possible ones only if not null).

The round draw by seeding (round rule `0x400`): the teams leave the ties, are sorted by seed (highest first), and each goes to a drawn tie. `sort_round_teams(cup, round)`. 1) It takes the teams out of the ties into an array of 7-byte entries (`exe::crt_malloc` of 7 × slots `cup_round::TEAMS`; out of memory, the box of line `0xbf8` and the game stops), each with its seed (`+4` of the team). 2) Sorts by seed, highest first (`exe::crt_qsort` with `0x51ebc0`). 3) Each entry with a team (up to the first without one, level `0xff`) goes to a drawn tie (`exe::utils_random` over the ties), moving round in a circle: on the first pass, only ties with both slots empty (< 0): with both free (−2), the drawn side (`exe::utils_random(2)` ≠ 0: home); only home free: home; only away free: away. From the second pass on (the flag is never reset to zero), any free slot, but with round rule 4 (`draw_rules::SEPARATE_NATIONS` of `cup_round::DRAW_RULES`) a free home slot is not allowed when the away team of the tie is from the same nation, and a free away slot is not allowed when the home team is; after going all the way round again, the nation rule is dropped (also for the following entries) and, without it, the box of line `0xcff` and it exits. Frees the array (`exe::crt_free`).

The round draw that keeps nations apart (round rule 4 without `0x400`): each team's level becomes how many teams of its nation are in the round (the bigger nations go first) and, from the second pass on, a team does not land in a tie with another of its nation while possible. `check_round_teams_for_nation(cup, round)`. It counts the teams of each nation in a zeroed array of `G_NATION_COUNT` bytes (`exe::crt_calloc`; out of memory, the box of line `0xd27` and the game stops) while taking the teams out of the ties (malloc of 7 × slots, the box of line `0xd34`), using `+0` of the club's nation (`club::NATION`); the level of each entry with a team becomes its nation's count (with no nation, the seed stays); it frees the counts and sorts, highest first (the nations with more teams go first). Each entry (up to the first with `0xff`) goes to a drawn tie, in a circle: on the first pass, only ties with no team in either slot (with both free, the drawn side; with only one free, that one); from the second on (the flag stays), any free slot, except (while the rule holds, and it is restored for each entry) a tie with a team of the same nation as the entry's club; after going all the way round again, the rule is dropped and, without it, the box of line `0xe5c` and it exits. Frees the array.
the base cup season start: clears the byte `run_by_stages`

Pays the round prize money: the winner gets the news item and the money, the loser only the money; the fund loses both. `pay_round_prize_money(winner, loser, round, fixture)` (`winner` and `loser`: 6-byte entries of the two teams). The round prizes are `winner_prize()` (winner) and `loser_prize()` (loser); with −1 for the winner, the fund (`prize_fund()`) / (rounds `round_count()` − round) / ties (`ties()`), and with −1 for the loser as well, 3/4 to the winner and 1/4 to the loser. The winner (if the prize is not zero) gets the news item (`send_prize_news`: the team's outcome `+5`, 3 if it was 1 in fixture `round_name::THIRD_PLACE_PLAYOFF_ALT`, and the next round: its word `cup_round::ROUND_CODE` if it is neither the last nor `0x8c`, over the high 16 bits of the round pointer, as the original leaves in ebp) and the money (`european_cup_add_prize_money` on the finances `european_cup_club_finance`); the loser only the money; the fund loses both.

Swaps home and away in one tie or in every tie of the round by the round rule: the club in the higher division (virtual `cup_vtable::CLUB_IN_HIGHER_DIVISION`), the team level or the cup stadium. `set_home_teams_for_round(round, laco)` (round, tie): in one tie (`laco`) or in all those of the round (−1), with both teams decided (≠ −1), it swaps home and away by the round rule (low byte of `cup_round::DRAW_RULES`): bit 1, if virtual `cup_vtable::CLUB_IN_HIGHER_DIVISION` (club_in_higher_division(club a, club b)) returns club b; otherwise bit 8, if the level (`+4` of the team, signed) of a is lower than b's; otherwise, with the cup stadium (`venue_stadium_id()`) ≠ −1, if club b exists, has a stadium (`club::STADIUM`) and its id (`+0`) is the cup's.

Records how far the team went in the cup, by outcome and round (with or without a third-place round), through virtual `comp_vtable::SET_CLUB_PROGRESS` (`set_club_progress(club, competition stage_index(), p1, p2, p3)`). `record_team_progress(team, round)`. With a last round of type `0x8c` (third place): in the semi-final (rounds − 2), outcome 1 or 2 → (d, d, d); in the last one, 3 or 4 → (d, d, d); in another round, outcome ≠ 0 → the round's `+0x5b` three times; 0 → (4, 1, 4) before the semi-final, otherwise (x, 1, x) with `+0x5b` of the next round. Without it: in the final, 1 → (1, 1, 1), 2 → the ties (`+0x1a`) of the final + 1 three times; in another round, outcome ≠ 0 → `+0x5b` three times; 0 → (x, 1, x) with the ties + 1 of the final before it, otherwise `+0x5b` of the next round. Outcomes other than these call nothing.

Draws a cup round: with some team still open it puts the draw off by 1 day; otherwise it draws by the round rule, sets the home teams and the shared stadium, marks the drawn ties and sends the draw news to human-managed teams. Returns 1. Convention: thiscall, ret 4, `Cup.cpp`, SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path. `draw_round(round)`. Without `season_set_up()` or with the round already drawn (`cup_tie::FIXTURE_STATE` of the first tie): nothing. With a team of some tie still without a club: the draw date moves 1 day (`FN_DATE_ADD_DAYS`, `exe::date_operator_3d`) and those of the following rounds become at least that date. Otherwise it draws: rule `tie_rules::SEEDED_DRAW` (`cup_round::TIE_RULES`) by seeding (`0x51d2d0`), rule 4 (`cup_round::DRAW_RULES`) keeping nations apart (`0x51d9f0`), without `tie_rules::FIXED_BRACKET` the open draw (`0x51e220`); the home teams (`exe::cup_set_home_teams_for_round` with −1); shared stadium (`cup_round::LEGS` = 2, `0x522610`); marks the drawn ties (`cup_tie::FIXTURE_STATE` = 1). With news (skips_draw_news): a round that is not the third-place one (`cup_round::ROUND_CODE` ≠ `0x8c`) adds 1 to `next_draw_round()`; news item `0x27` (the competition, `stage_label()`, the type, `stage_index()`, the round, 0, and 1 if `current_round()` + 1 < `next_draw_round()`) goes to each of the teams still alive (outcome 0) among the first ones (sum of the entries `cup_round::NEW_TEAMS` of the rounds up to this one) that has a human manager, with the manager's id in data item 3.

Updates the staff records by the club's outcome in the cup: the winners record (and the UEFA Cup place through the English League Cup or a European nation's main cup), runners-up, third place, qualified for the next round or knocked out, weighted by round. Returns 0. Convention: thiscall, ret `0x18`, `Cup.cpp`; virtual `+0x44` of the English cups and of the base class. `update_staff_records_for_status(club, outcome, a3, a4, game, final_)` (`game`: the fixture). Nothing with fixture `category()` = `match_category::FRIENDLY`, with `stage_count()` or with `stage_index()` ≠ `stage_index::MAIN`. Outcome 1: the winners record and, with the place (wins_uefa_cup_place), the club's state receives the UEFA Cup (`KEY_CLUB_COMP_UEFA_CUP`); 2: runners-up; 3: third place; 0: if the next round (`round_number()` + 1) exists and is not the third-place one (`+7` ≠ `0x8c`), the qualification (`FN_STAFF_RECORDS_ADD_QUALIFIED_FOR_ROUND_RECORD`) with weight round × 99 / (rounds − 1) + 1; `0xff`: the knock-out (`FN_STAFF_RECORDS_ADD_KNOCKED_OUT_RECORD`) with weight round × 99 / rounds + 1. The stage records take the dwords the original pushes: the word of the fixture (`round_prefix()`, `round_name()`) or of the round (`+7`) over the high 16 bits of the register.

Records the season honours: finds the winner, runner-up, third (in the Welsh cup, through the statistics) and the host national team, writes the history row and, in the nation's main cup, passes the semi-final losers to UEFA. Convention: thiscall, ret 0, `Cup.cpp`; virtual `+0x30` of the English cups and of the base class. `Cup::record_season_honours()`: the history row (`exe::comp_util_add_history_record`: 5 pushes; add esp, `0x14` -> cdecl(cup, winner, runner-up, third, host)) with the four from season_honours; outside the friendly competition, in the nation's main cup (is_main_national_cup), the semi-finalists go to UEFA (`exe::cup_register_semi_final_losers_for_uefa`: ecx = the cup -> thiscall, ret 0).

Finds the semi-finals (`0x82`) and the final (`0x96`) and sends the two semi-finalists not in the final to the UEFA seeding. `Cup::register_semi_final_losers_for_uefa()`: the semi-finalists outside the final (semi_final_losers) go to the UEFA seeding (`exe::uefaseeding_record_cup_semi_final_losers`: push b; push a; push competition id; ecx = `G_UEFA_SEEDING`; no add esp -> thiscall, ret `0xc`).

Returns the club on one side of the fixture or, if that side is empty, the clubs that can still reach it. `get_fixture_side_teams(round, game, side, out)` (round, fixture, side, output): the club on one side of the fixture (side ≠ 0: `+0`; 0: `away_team()`) or, if empty, the clubs that can reach it (`exe::cup_collect_possible_teams` with the count in global `G_CUP_POSSIBLE_TEAM_COUNT`). Returns the count (the error box if none). Round outside 0..`round_count()`, a cup with no clubs (`team_table()`) or fixture −1: the original routine runs (the error box and 0).

The daily update of each cup: moves on completed stages and ends the cup, gives each stage the day and, on the date, draws (phase 0) or sets up (phase ≠ 0) the rounds until none advances. Returns 0. `update_for_date(today, stage)` (today, phase). A cup with no parent (`stage_index()` = `stage_index::MAIN`): with `run_by_stages()`, if stages 0..=`current_stage()` are complete (virtual `comp_vtable::CHECK_COMPLETE` with 0, 1), it moves to the next stage (virtual `comp_vtable::ADVANCE_STAGE`, if `current_stage()` < `stage_count()` − 1) or ends the cup once (`season_closed()`: the history `exe::club_history_record_comp_season` of `G_CLUB_HISTORY`, virtual `comp_vtable::RECORD_SEASON_HONOURS`, the records `exe::comp_stats_update_season_end_records` of Comp_Stats `+8`); then the records news (`exe::comp_stats_send_record_news`). Still with no parent, each stage receives the day (virtual `comp_vtable::UPDATE_FOR_DATE` with `G_CURRENT_DATE` and the phase). Phase 0 (with `G_CURRENT_DAY_SLICE` = 1): the last, final round (`+7` = `0x8c`) is drawn on its date (`exe::cup_draw_round`); without `run_by_stages()`, it draws the rounds from `next_draw_round()` whose date has arrived, until none advances or they run out. Phase ≠ 0 (with `season_set_up()`): the same with the round set-up (`exe::cup_set_up_round`) from `current_round()`, which also sets up on the round's pending date (`cup_tie::FIXTURE_STATE` of the round's stage).

Sets up a cup round: draws the round if needed, creates the fixtures of the marked ties, moves them to the round dates and moves on; a team without a club postpones the rounds by a day. `set_up_round(round)`: without `season_set_up()`: 1. Round outside 0..`round_count()` − 1: the error box (line `0xa64`) and −1. It draws the round if its stage has no `cup_tie::FIXTURE_STATE` (`exe::cup_draw_round`). In the current round (`current_round()`): if a tie (`0x35` bytes in the stage, `+0/+2` the teams or `0xffff`) has a team without a club (`team_table()`, 6 bytes), it postpones the requested round and the following ones by a day (`exe::date_add_days`, `exe::date_operator_3d`; the following ones only if they ended up earlier) and returns 1. Otherwise it creates the fixtures of each marked tie (`cup_tie::FIXTURE_STATE` = 1 deferred, 2 already: `exe::cup_create_tie_fixtures`; after the 2, without the cup in `G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE[id]`: 1), moves the fixtures to the round dates (date `+3/+5` in an 8-byte block, `exe::cup_move_round_fixtures_to_set_dates`, freed afterwards) and, with the cup in `G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE[id]`, moves on to the next round (except the final `0x8c`) and takes `next_draw_round()` along. Returns 1.

The open draw of the round's teams: takes the teams out of the round ties, shuffles them and puts each one in a drawn tie (empty ones first), drawing the side when both slots are free, and sets the link to the next round. `randomize_round_teams(cup, round)`. 1) It takes the teams out of the ties (`cup_round::TIES` of the round) into an array of 7 bytes per slot (`exe::crt_malloc` of 7 × slots `cup_round::TEAMS`; out of memory, box of line `0xe7f` and the game stops): the home team (`+0`, with the link `+0xe/+0xa`) and the away team (`+2`, with `+0x10/+0xc`), each with the team level (`+4` of the team); the tie slot becomes −2 (free); with no team (−1), the entry stays −1 (with `0xff` in the level). 2) Shuffles: for each position, swaps with the entry drawn among all of them (`exe::utils_random(n)`). 3) Each entry with a team goes to a drawn tie (`exe::utils_random` over the ties), moving round in a circle: on the first pass only ties with both slots empty (< 0); then any with a free slot (−2); after going all the way round on the second pass, box of line `0xf4c` and it exits (the second-pass flag is never reset to zero). With both slots free, it draws the side (`exe::utils_random(2)`: ≠ 0 home). The team carries its link (`+0xe/+0xa` or `+0x10/+0xc`) and, with a link, the tie of the next round receives the round (`set_feeder_round`), the drawn tie (`set_feeder_tie`) and the side (`set_feeder_side`: 1 home, 0 away). Frees the array (`exe::crt_free`).

Swaps home and away in the later tie whose team shares a stadium with a team of an earlier tie of the round, and sets the side in the linked ties. `separate_shared_stadium_ties(cup, round)`: for each tie `i` of the round, it looks for the first `j > i` whose home team (or, failing that, the away team) shares the stadium (`club::STADIUM`, not null) with the home (or the away) team of `i`; if found, it swaps tie `j` (home and away, `+0xa/+0xc` and `+0xe/+0x10`) and fixes the side (`+8`) of the linked ties in the next round: the one at `home_link_round()`/`home_link_tie()` becomes 1 (home), the one at `away_link_round()`/`away_link_tie()` becomes 0. The two fixtures in the same stadium no longer fall on the same side.

Decides who goes through in a cup match (1 home, 2 away, 0 nobody) by the rule (`tie_rules()`), storing each side's code (`home_result_mark()`/`away_result_mark()`). `decide_fixture_winner(game)` (fixture): by the score (`home_goals()`/`away_goals()`), extra time (bit 2, `home_goals_extra_time()`/`away_goals_extra_time()`), penalties (bits `0x21`, `home_penalties()`/`away_penalties()`), the walkover (`0x800`/`0x1000`) and the points (`0x2000`: codes −1 and the seeded team). The code of each side (`home_result_mark()`/`away_result_mark()`): 2 won, 3 in extra time, 4/5 on penalties, 8 walkover; −3 with `0x2000`. Null fixture or a draw on penalties: the original routine runs ("Error" box).

Decides a two-legged tie: in the first leg it marks the winner and returns 3; in the second leg it decides by aggregate, walkover, extra time, away goals and penalties (1 or 2 the side through, 4 undecided). Convention: thiscall, ret 8, `Cup.cpp`; `this` is not read. `decide_tie_winner(tie, game)` (tie, fixture): in the first leg (`cup_tie::NEXT_MATCH` ≠ 1), it only marks the winner (points `0x10`: code 1; `0x2000`: −3, or −1 for both) and returns 3. In the second leg, by the aggregate (`cup_tie::FIRST_MATCH_HOME_GOALS` + `cup_tie::SECOND_MATCH_AWAY_GOALS` against `cup_tie::SECOND_MATCH_HOME_GOALS` + `cup_tie::FIRST_MATCH_AWAY_GOALS`): 2 if the first side is ahead, 1 the second; level: walkover (`0x800`/`0x1000`, code 8), extra time (bit 2 with `cup_tie::SECOND_MATCH_HOME_EXTRA_TIME_GOALS` ≠ `0xff`: with `0x4000` the away goals in it; code 6, otherwise the extra-time difference, code 3), away goals (without 4 or `0x4000`, code 6) and penalties (`0x21`, `cup_tie::SECOND_MATCH_HOME_PENALTIES`/`cup_tie::SECOND_MATCH_AWAY_PENALTIES`: code 4 with bit 1, otherwise 5); nothing decided: 4. Points (`0x10`) and rule `0x2000` have their own branches. A draw on penalties: the original routine runs ("Error" box, 4).

Copies the round rules onto the match and, with a decision on a draw, marks who goes through by both sides' levels. It passes the rules of the match's round (word `cup_round::TWO_LEG_TIE_RULES` of round `game.round_number()`) to the match flags (`fixture::TIE_RULES`, OR). With flag `0x800` (decides who goes through on a draw), the level (byte `+4` of the slot, signed) of the two sides of tie `key` decides: home team lower removes `0x800` and sets `0x1000`; higher keeps `0x800`; equal removes `0x800` and sets 1.

Returns the tie of the match's round (`round_number()`) that holds the match's home club (`home_club_id()`), or -1 if none. It looks at both sides of each tie (53 bytes; a negative slot is empty). The number of ties is word `cup_round::TIES` of the round. Null match: the original routine runs (error box).

Returns the cup match importance by round and the first-leg score difference. The importance is the match stage `round_number()` minus `round_count()` plus the cup's `importance_bias()`, at least 1; in `margin` it puts the first-leg score difference (`home_aggregate()`/`away_aggregate()`, `0xff` with no first leg) for side `second`, plus 1 (`0xff` below 1). Returns only `al`.

Outside friendlies, calls the competition's virtual `comp_vtable::UPDATE_STAFF_RECORDS_FOR_STATUS` and posts news item `0x10` about the team's result (club, competition, outcome, result category, the match, the next round), delivered by scope, to the competition region (final and third-place match) or to the club manager. Convention: thiscall, ret `0x14`, `Cup.cpp`, SEH frame with no destructor. `add_team_result_news(club, outcome, a3, p, a5)` (club, outcome, a3, match, a5): friendly (`exe::friendly_is_friendly_competition`), 0. The competition's virtual `comp_vtable::UPDATE_STAFF_RECORDS_FOR_STATUS` (`G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE` by the id at `+4`) with the club, the outcome, a3, the output (`0xff`), the match and a5; −1 from it or no match: 0. News item `0x10` (local): 0 the club, 1 the competition, 2 the outcome, 3 the result category (`exe::comp_util_classify_tie_result_for_news`), 4 what the virtual returned, the match from data item 5 on (`exe::comp_util_write_fixture_to_news_slots`, which advances the cursor) and at the cursor the next round (`cup_round::ROUND_CODE` of round `round_number()` + 1, up to `round_count()` − 1; `0x8c` or outside: −1). Output ≠ `0xff`: delivery by scope (`exe::news_send_by_scope`). Outcome 1 in round `0x96` or 3 in `0x8c` (`round_name()`): to the competition region (`exe::news_send_to_comp_region`); otherwise to the club manager (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`). Returns 1.

Tells whether the cup is complete: it has started (`run_by_stages()`) and, when asked for the stages with no stage set (`stage_index()`), all stages up to the current one are complete and the current one is the last. `check_complete(stages, _x)`: 0 if the cup has not started (`run_by_stages()`). With `stages` = 1 and no stage set (`stage_index()` = `stage_index::MAIN`): each stage from 0 up to the current one (`current_stage()`, array `stages()`) must be complete (method `comp_vtable::CHECK_COMPLETE` with 0, 1) and the current one must be the last (`stage_count()` − 1); otherwise 0. Apart from that, 1.

In rounds with set dates, moves each round fixture to the weekday and time slot of its match-day slot, with the news, the stadium and the calendar; the used slot becomes empty. Convention: thiscall, ret 8, `Cup.cpp`, SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path (the local news items, date and list). `move_round_fixtures_to_set_dates(data, round)` (date, round), called from the round set-up (`0x51c800`, in Rust). The local news item `0x14` is built right away (`exe::new_newsitem`). A round (`0x68` bytes at `+0xa3`) with `tie_rules::FIXED_DATES` in `cup_round::TIE_RULES` and the first slot set (`cup_round::SLOT_CODE` ≠ `0xff`): the cup fixtures on that date and time slot (collect_round_fixtures). With fixtures, the news carries the cup id, `stage_label()`, the round code (`+7`) and whether the round is two-legged (`cup_round::LEGS` = 2). Each fixture of the league's type (`fixture::STAGE_INDEX`) takes a slot (7 bytes from `cup_round::SLOT_VENUE`: `+0` stadium rules, `+4` weekday (`cup_round::SLOT_WEEKDAY`), `+5` time slot (`cup_round::SLOT_TIME_SLICE`), `+6` type (`cup_round::SLOT_CODE`); up to 8, up to the first `0xff`): on the round date, it goes to the slot's weekday (`exe::new_date` in an 8-byte block from `exe::crt_operator_new`, `exe::date_get_nearest_weekday`, freed afterwards), with news item 3 to the clubs outside type 3, leaves the calendar (`exe::fixture_manager_remove_fixture`), takes the slot's date, time slot and type, the stadium (`exe::stadium_set_fixture_venue`) and goes back in (`exe::fixture_manager_add_fixture`); without the cup still in `G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE`, it stops; otherwise the slot becomes `0xff`. With or without the change, news item `0x14` goes to the clubs if one has a human manager. With no slot (end of the slots or an empty slot): only the news, with the fixture data.

Builds the cup's fixture tree: allocates the ties of each round, clears them, links each tie to a slot in the next round (by pair or drawn, the side by a coin toss; with no slot, two rounds ahead), puts each round's teams into its ties (drawn, the cup nation's club at home) and numbers the first tie of each round. Returns 1. `Cup::map_fixture_tree()`, called when the cups are created (22 calls up to 2002-06-01). The tie arrays of each round (`exe::crt_malloc`: 4 per round and `0x35` per tie; out of memory, the "Memory Allocation Error" box of line `0x8b` or `0x9e` and the game stops; a round with no ties, the box of line `0x95` and -1); flag `+5` of each team (`team_table()`, 6 bytes) and `current_round()`/`next_draw_round()` cleared. With clubs (`season_set_up()`): each tie empty (the teams and the slots −1, `cup_tie::FEEDER_SIDE` = 0, `+0x14..+0x31` = `0xff`, `cup_tie::REPLAYS_PLAYED`..`cup_tie::FIXTURE_STATE` = 0). In the rounds up to the second-to-last (the third-to-last when the last is of type `0x8c`): the order of the ties (shuffled in drawn pairs if the next round has fewer than half); each one gets its slot in the next round: by pair (round `cup_round::TIE_RULES` bit `0x200`: p/2) or drawn (with bit `0x400`, the first fully free slot from there), the side by coin toss (`exe::utils_random(2)`; if taken, the next slot and another toss); with no free slot, a slot drawn two rounds ahead (without it, the game stops: lines `0x175` and `0x1a0`). The tie stores the slot (`cup_tie::FEEDER_TIE`), the side (`cup_tie::FEEDER_SIDE`: 1 home) and the destination round (`cup_tie::FEEDER_ROUND`); the slot stores the tie (`+0xa/+0xc`) and the source round (`+0xe/+0x10`). Then the teams of each round (`cup_round::NEW_TEAMS`, from `cup_round::FIRST_NEW_TEAM`) go into its ties: the first by pair or drawn (`tie_rules::SEEDED_DRAW`: the first fully free), the side by coin toss, and in a taken slot the team of nation `venue_stadium_id()` becomes the home team (no slot: the box of line `0x1c2` or `0x222` and -1). With no ties in the first round, `run_by_stages` = 1. Finally the number of the first tie of each round (`cup_round::FIRST_TIE_NUMBER`), from back to front.

Sorts the cup clubs by strength and gives each one the predicted position of the round it goes out in, in the cup statistics. `Cup::rank_teams()`: copies the cup clubs (`team_table()`, 6-byte records, `team_count()` of them) into an array (`exe::crt_malloc`), sorts by strength (`exe::comp_util_sort_clubs_by_strength`) and gives each one the predicted position by the round it goes out in (`set_final_positions_by_round` in the statistics `[+8]`); frees the array (`exe::crt_free`). No statistics: the error box (line `0x1827`); out of memory: the original routine runs (the out-of-memory box and the end of the game).

Stores one of the eight cup round match days: the venue flags, the weekday, the time slot and the code. Returns the venue flags. Day `slot` (0 to 7) of round `round` (104-byte records): in 7 bytes from `cup_round::SLOT_VENUE`, the venue (4 bytes), the weekday (`slot_weekday`, −1 to 6), the time slot (`slot_time_slice`, −1 to 2) and the code (`slot_code`, −1 to 3). Out of range: the original routine runs (error box and end of the game).

The Serie A day; at season end, two clubs level on points in different bands are not split by goal difference: the first such pair from the top is ordered by head-to-head and goes to an extra match (the next stage); with no tie on a boundary, the season closes. Convention: thiscall, ret 8, `ita_ser_a.cpp`, slot `+0x14`. `ItaSerA::update_for_date(today, full)` (today, complete). First the league day (`exe::league_update_for_date`: push complete; push today; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 8), whose return value it passes on. Then, at the end of the season (`complete()`), in the main stage (`stage_count()` = 0, no stages created), with `full` and with `tiebreak_matches()` [inference: the table closed]: it clears `season_closed` and looks, from top to bottom, for the first pair of neighbouring clubs with the same points in different bands (serie_a_zones). If found: it orders the tied clubs by head-to-head (`exe::ita_league_sort_clubs_level_on_points`: push points; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 4), creates the array of 1 stage (`stage_count` = 1, `stages` = `exe::crt_malloc` of 4: push 4; add esp, 4 -> cdecl) and calls virtual `comp_vtable::ADVANCE_STAGE` (the next stage: the tie-break match). With no tie on a boundary: `complete` = 0, `tiebreak_matches` = 0 and virtual `league_vtable::UPDATE_POSITIONS_AND_STATUS` (League::update_positions_and_status). The rule: in Italy, a tie on points between clubs in different bands (the title; Italy's Champions League places; the UEFA Cup places; the next two [inference: the Intertoto]; relegation, the last `+0xc1` of 18) is not decided by goal difference: it goes to an extra match.

Updates the staff records by status in Serie A: in the league, the base records; in the tie-break match, the winner (status 1 [inference: the club won]) is placed above the other in the table (the rows swap if it was below) and, with no play-off pending, the season closes. Returns −1 in the tie-break case. Convention: thiscall, ret `0x18`, `ita_ser_a.cpp`, slot `+0x44`. `ItaSerA::update_staff_records_for_status(club, status, stage, a4, game, a6)` (club, status, stage, a4, match, a6). In the league (stage `0xff`): the base version (`exe::league_update_staff_records_for_status`: push a6; push match; push a4; push -1; push status; push club; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret `0x18`), whose return value it passes on. In the tie-break match (any other stage), only with status 1: `table_column` = 0, sorts the table (`exe::league_sort_table`: push 0; mov ecx -> thiscall, ret 4) and finds the club's row: if the club above is one of the two in the match (`fixture::HOME_CLUB`, `fixture::AWAY_CLUB`), the two rows swap places; otherwise, if the club below is one of them, they stay. In both cases the two rows get their position (`+4`) and an open destination (`league_table_row::STATUS` = `0xff`). Then, if no row has destination 1 (the play-off above), it closes the season: `tiebreak_matches` = 0, `complete` = 0, virtual `league_vtable::UPDATE_POSITIONS_AND_STATUS`, virtual `comp_vtable::CHECK_COMPLETE` (0, 0) and `complete` = 1. The rule: the winner of the tie-break match finishes ahead of the other.

Creates the Serie A table: 18 clubs; the prize fund starts at 250,000 per place (paid by table position when the league ends); TV pays 5,000,000 to each club. `ItaSerA::create_table()`: 18 clubs (`KEY_CLUB_COMP_ITALIAN_SERIE_A`); once full, the fund by the 250,000 share and the TV money of 5,000,000 to each club (`exe::league_pay_tv_rights`: thiscall(league, value, 0), ret 8); returns 1 (0 if it could not fill). Source `0x9ea2a8`, line `0x253`.

`SpaSecond::create_table()`: the Segunda has 22 clubs (`club_count`), those of the competition in database order. The table (`exe::crt_malloc` of 0x512: push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; out of memory, the error box at line 0x298 and 0) receives, in database order (`G_CLUB_TABLE`, `G_CLUB_COUNT` clubs of `club::SIZE` bytes), the clubs of the competition of id `KEY_CLUB_COMP_SPANISH_SECOND_DIVISION` until it is full (`exe::league_init_table_row`: push 0; push 0; push club; push row (the pushed word has the row byte with stack garbage above it; `exe::league_init_table_row` reads only the byte); mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0x10); the B team of a Primera club (`KEY_CLUB_COMP_SPANISH_FIRST_DIVISION`) gets fate −4 (+0x37 = 0xfc: cannot go up). Full: the prize fund (`set_prize_fund` = `exe::league_calc_prize_fund`: push 50000; mov ecx -> thiscall, ret 4), `prize_mode` = 1 and 1; otherwise 0.

The neutral venue search: in the venue list sorted by nation, continent or capacity, it looks at up to 30 candidates of the key; the ordinary neutral venue is the free one with the best score; the host rotation of a tournament (flags `0x40..0x4000`) takes the candidate whose position modulo 9 matches the flag; failing that, the national stadium (flags 4/8/`0x20`) or none. `find_available_venue(marks, cont, nation, data, home, away, fixture)` (flags, continent, nation, date, home, away, fixture). The venue list is this `stadium_obj::VENUES`, count `stadium_obj::VENUE_COUNT`; 16-byte slots: `+0` the nation, `+4` the continent, `+8` 1 if it is a club ground [inference], `stadium_venue::STADIUM` the stadium. It is sorted (`exe::crt_qsort`) by nation (with a nation; flag `stadium_obj::VENUE_SORT` = 1), by continent (with a continent; 2) or only by capacity (3). With a nation or continent, the binary search (`exe::crt_bsearch`) finds the first slot of the key; with neither, it starts from the first. It looks at up to 30 slots (never the last one in the list), skipping the stashed venue (`G_STADIUM_STASHED_VENUE_ID`) and, in club matches with flags < `0x40`, both clubs' grounds; it stops at the first slot of another key. Flags without `0x40`/`0x80`/`0x7f00` (the ordinary neutral venue): with 4 only club slots, with 2 only the others; among those free on the date (`is_stadium_free`), the one with the best score (`exe::stadium_score_venue_for_fixture`), which is booked (`add_stadium_booking`, with the fixture). With `0x40..0x4000` (the host rotation of a tournament): the non-club slot whose (counted) position modulo 9 is the flag's (`0x40` → 0, `0x80` → 1, `0x100` → 2 ... `0x4000` → 8), free on the date (or, in competition `KEY_CLUB_COMP_WORLD_CUP_OCEANIA_QUALIFYING_SECTION`, without checking), is booked and returned. With nothing found: with a nation, flags without 2 and with 4/8/`0x20`, that nation's national stadium (`national_stadium()`); otherwise 0.

Sets the fixture venue (`set_stadium` the pointer, `set_stadium_id` the id, -1 if none; `fixture::NEUTRAL_VENUE` 1 on neutral ground). Convention: thiscall, ret `0xc`, `stadium.cpp`; this = `G_STADIUM`. `set_fixture_venue(marks, fixture, estadio)` (flags, fixture, stadium). Null fixture: the error box (line `0x1f0`). The date is the fixture's (`day()` the day, `year()` the year). The rules, by flags: `0x8000`: the Monaco ground (`G_KEY_CLUB_AS_MONACO`), if neither club is Monaco; otherwise as 4. 4: in the English club competition (competition nation `nation()` = `KEY_NATION_ENGLAND`), with the stashed venue (`G_STADIUM_STASHED_VENUE_ID` != -1), the Welsh national stadium (`KEY_NATION_WALES`: the Millennium, while Wembley is being rebuilt); otherwise as the others. 0 (the ordinary match): the England national team before 2003 goes to neutral ground (as `0x20`); in the Champions League (`KEY_CLUB_COMP_UEFA_EUROPEAN_CHAMPIONS_LEAGUE`) with a Finnish team (`KEY_NATION_FINLAND`) outside stage `stage_index::MAIN`, if the Finnish national stadium is free on the date (without the booking, `FN_CRT_BSEARCH` with `0x85e380`) and the club ground has fewer than 40,000 seats, it plays there (booked); otherwise the home club's ground (`stadium()`), except Italian or French clubs in a friendly (`exe::friendly_is_friendly_competition`, they go to neutral ground as `0x20`); with no ground: a national team as `0x20`, a club none. `0x10`: the stadium `estadio` (table `G_STADIUM_TABLE`, `0x4e` bytes), without it none; 1: none. The others (neutral ground): the competition hosts in year `season_year()` (`exe::hostcountry_find_hosts`): with two, the first and the second swap roles according to the rotation flags (`0x40`/`0x100`/`0x400`/`0x1000`/`0x4000` → 4/`0x40`/`0x80`/`0x100`/`0x200`, the second as alternative; `0x80`/`0x200`/`0x800`/`0x2000` → `0x40`/`0x80`/`0x100`/`0x200`, the first as alternative); with one, that one; with none, the competition nation (`nation()`). With `0x20`, a national team plays in its own country. With 4, the nation's national stadium (booked); without it, `0x20` (national team) or `0x40`. Then the neutral venue search (`FN_STADIUM_FIND_AVAILABLE_VENUE`) in the nation and, failing that, in the alternative (flags `0x40..0x200` → `0x400..0x2000`).

Computes the match attendance, writes the total, the home and the away crowd to `out` and returns the total. Convention: thiscall, ret 8, `stadium.cpp`; this = `G_STADIUM`; called by the match engine `0x6b7f20`. `calculate_match_attendance(game, out)` (fixture, output). With no fixture, `G_STADIUM_DEFAULT_ATTENDANCE` (15,000). R = club reputation (`club::REPUTATION`) / 500 (at least 1). For each side, the factor starts at the number of clubs in the competition (`reputation()`, at least 1; with no competition 1), +2 in competitions of type 6, 8 and 10; in leagues (table `G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE`, outside friendlies `exe::friendly_is_friendly_competition` and the nations of `FN_COMP_IS_RESERVE_OR_MINOR_COMP`, without `league::COMP_TYPE` = 2) plus the difference (`round_number()` of the fixture − `league::LEGS` of the league, between −6 and 5). The home factor times the away R / its own R (if it has R < 15 or below the other's), ×1.1 with the other above 17, ×1.25 with the other above 12 and it below 14; divided by the number of clubs in the club's league (`club::DIVISION` → `reputation()`), without one ×0.2 (type 10) or ×0.05. The away factor, the same with the roles swapped. Floors by competition type (apply_side_factor_floor: cups 8, 6 and 5 with the limits `+0x30`/`+0x32` and the reputation; 10 1.25; 9 0.8; otherwise 0.1). With a stadium off neutral ground: the cities of the stadium and of the two clubs (drawn when there is no city), the distance factor (`exe::stadium_get_travel_distance_factor`, at least 0.15); the home side gets the average (`attendance()`) × factor × distance, the away side (`attendance()` + `min_attendance()`) × factor × distance × 0.5; in the home club's league, by position (`exe::comp_stats_find_club_entry` on the league table): +50/100/150 per club at the top, +25/50 in the race, −25/−10 at the bottom, and by form (`+0x72`/`+0x73`/`+0x74`); in the ground of a club's city, its crowd between the minimum (`min_attendance()`) and the maximum (`max_attendance()`). With no stadium or on neutral ground: average × factor. Derby (`club::RIVAL1`/`club::RIVAL2`/`club::RIVAL3`): ×1.5 (same city ×1.35); rival away side ×1.35; off neutral ground with `stage()` != `0xff` ×1.05 and ×0.85. In the league with `own_stadium()`: the minimum by the number of clubs in the league (and the maximum with up to 4 clubs). A stadium with fewer than 1,500 seats becomes R × 1,000 (at least 1,500). Limits by capacity (the away side up to max(5%, min(capacity − away average × home factor, 15%)) and the home side the rest; neutral half), with no stadium 40,000 and 25,000; with no crowd, 1 to 50 and 1 to 15. Total = home + away − random(50) (negative: 45 to 194).

Scores a venue for a neutral fixture: the English national stadium before 2004 scores 0; the score starts at 100000, changes with the city distances (flag 8) or with the seats against the expected crowd (flag `0x20`) or becomes random(seats) (flag 4), and ends × (random(100) × 0.004 + 0.8). `score_venue_for_fixture(est, marks, home, away, game)` (stadium, flags, home, away, match), called by the neutral venue search `0x85c800` (with flags `0x20` in career matches). The English national stadium (nation `KEY_NATION_ENGLAND` `national_stadium()`) before 2004: 0. The score starts at 100000: flags & 8, with the cities of both clubs (`stadium()` → `city()`) and the stadium's (`city()`) and more than 10000 seats (`capacity()`): by the distances d1 (home-away), d2 (home-stadium), d3 (away-stadium): with d1 < 30, 200000/180000/140000 if d2 and d3 < 15/30/50 and 50000 if either exceeds 100; otherwise 200000 if both < 0.588·d1 and 50000 if either ≥ 0.8333·d1. flags & `0x20`: the expected crowd (10000; home national team 60000; otherwise the sum of the crowds `attendance()` of both clubs, at least 5000 and, above 40000, half of it without going below either of the two); seats above it: × 1.2; above 1.5× it: / ((seats − 1.5·expected)·8.33e-5 + 1); below 0.3/0.5/0.7/0.9 of it: × 0.1/0.3/0.7/0.9. Otherwise, with flags & 4: the score is random(seats). At the end, score × (random(100) × 0.004 + 0.8), truncated.

Returns the travel distance factor for the attendance: 1 − distance × k (squared without `neutral_venue()`), divided by (reputation + 1)² when far and with reputation, with several minimums. Returns the double in st0. `get_travel_distance_factor(game, cid_est, cid_club, base)` (match, stadium city, club city, base), in the match attendance (`0x85cba0`, called by the engine `0x6b7f20`). D = distance between the cities (halved with match `round_name()` = `0xa0` and `category()` = 5); F = 1 − D·`rdata::F64_0_1333333333`, squared without `neutral_venue()`; with D and the reputation R (`state_of_development()` of nation `nation()` of the away club `away_club()`) above `rdata::F64_0`: F / (R + 1)². With base above `rdata::F64_14`, the minimum 1 − (`rdata::F64_20` − base)·`rdata::F64_0_15`; with `category()` = 10, the minimum 0.2; with both clubs of the same nation, 0.05; and always `rdata::F64_0_03`.

The stadium daily update: on day 0 it rebuilds the venue list; before 2003 it closes the England national stadium and reopens it on 1/6/2003 with 90000 seats; every 30 days it removes the expired bookings and re-sorts. `daily_update(today)` (today), every day from the game's day loop (`G_STADIUM`). On day 0 of the year it rebuilds the venue list (`exe::stadium_build_venue_list`). Before 2003, the England national stadium (nation `nation::NATIONAL_STADIUM`) closes: the id goes to `G_STADIUM_STASHED_VENUE_ID`, the nation and the senior national team (`club::STADIUM`) are left without a stadium. On 1/6/2003 (`exe::date_date_549f70`) it comes back with 90000 seats (`stadium::CAPACITY`, `stadium::SEATING_CAPACITY`). Every 30 days, the bookings (list at `+0`, count at `stadium_obj::BOOKING_COUNT`, 12 bytes: id and date) before today are removed: the original counts the first k (year unsigned, day signed), copies over them, moving forward, the k that start at n − k − 1 (not at n − k) and re-sorts the n − k (`sort_stadium_list`: `0x945333` with `0x85e380`).

Appends a booking (stadium id and date) to the list, which grows 30 at a time, and re-sorts by date and id. `add_booking(stadium, data)` (stadium, date): appends the booking (stadium id, copy of the date via `exe::date_operator_3d`) to the list (`+0`; count `stadium_obj::BOOKING_COUNT`, capacity `stadium_obj::BOOKING_CAPACITY`), which starts with 30 (`exe::crt_malloc`, `0x168` bytes) and grows 30 at a time (`exe::crt_realloc`), and re-sorts (`sort_stadium_list`: `0x945333` with `0x85e380`). Null stadium or date, or out of memory: the "Error" box (lines `0x810`, `0x81b`, `0x82b`). Called by the venue choice (`0x85c260`, `0x85c800`).

Returns 1 when there is no booking of the stadium on the date. `is_stadium_free_on_date(stadium, data)` (stadium, date): 1 with no booking list; otherwise 1 if the binary search (`exe::crt_bsearch` with `0x85e380`) does not find the booking (stadium id, date copied via `exe::date_operator_3d`). Called by the neutral venue choice (`0x85c800`).

Rebuilds the list of venues for neutral-ground matches (finals and semi-finals): grounds with a city, nation and continent qualify, except the City of Manchester Stadium (under construction) and, in nations with competitions, those under 5000 seats; each nation's national stadium is flagged. `Stadium::build_venue_list`: `stadium_obj::VENUES` the list of 16-byte records, `stadium_obj::VENUE_COUNT` the count, `stadium_obj::VENUE_CAPACITY` the capacity; the old list is released. The hosts of the next editions of three competitions (keys `KEY_CLUB_COMP_FIFA_WORLD_CUP`, `KEY_CLUB_COMP_EUROPEAN_FOOTBALL_CHAMPIONSHIP`, `KEY_CLUB_COMP_AFRICAN_CUP_OF_NATIONS`; `exe::hostcountry_find_next_hosts` on HostCountry `G_HOST_COUNTRY`, without it the box of line `0x858`) are found, but change nothing (their loop ends the same way on both paths). The stadiums that go in (records of `0x4e` bytes in `G_STADIUM_TABLE`, count `G_STADIUM_COUNT`) are those with a city (`city()`), the city's nation (`city::NATION`) and the nation's continent (`continent()`), except the "City of Manchester Stadium" (still under construction in 2001) and, in nations with competitions (`league_selected()`), those with fewer than 5000 seats (`capacity()`). Each record: `+0` the nation id, `+4` the continent id, `+8` whether it is the national stadium (`national_stadium()` of the nation), `stadium_venue::STADIUM` the stadium. The list grows 30 at a time (`exe::crt_malloc`, realloc `exe::crt_realloc`; out of memory, the boxes of lines `0x89c` and `0x8ac`, and it stops). At the end it is sorted (`exe::crt_qsort` with `0x85e2f0`) and `stadium_obj::VENUE_SORT` = 1.
venue qsort: places (`capacity()`) of the stadium (`stadium_venue::STADIUM`), largest first; without a stadium, 0

Posts the news of a fined player's reaction: for a player under contract at a human club, news 0xbc6 with reason, reaction, random(2), personality, period, contract type, future transfer and effects. SEH frame for the local news item, no destructor. `post_fine_reaction_news(player, reason, reaction, deadline, efeitos)`, called from the fine (0x5a5980, five calls). No player, no contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`, on `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`), no club of his or no club contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract_for_club`): nothing; player of a club (`club_job()`) without a human (`club_has_human_manager`): nothing. News 0xbc6 to the contract's club: the player (id and keys), reason, reaction, random(2), the personality (`temperament()` + `professionalism()` below 12, `loyalty()` below 6 and reputation `current_reputation()` above 5250), period 1, the type 7 contract (`squad_status()`), the future transfer (`exe::transfer_manager_get_future_transfer`), the effects and the game by the type (`squad_status()` 1 with more than 23 years, or 2).

Posts the coach's feedback on a fine: with player and coach both having a record and a nation, and the player having a club, news 0x1394 with the outcome and random(5). SEH frame for the local news item, no destructor. `post_coach_fine_feedback_news(player, coach, outcome)`, called from the fines' daily pass (0x5a5820: the feedback marked as due, more than 30 days at the club and no serious injury; the original leaves the Fine in ecx). Both with a record (`player()`) and a nation (`nation()`), the player with a club (`club_job()`): news 0x1394 (the player and the coach, id and keys; the outcome; random(5)) to the player's club.
marks (`formation_fields::MARKING_TYPES`) with 4 and 8 become 2; assigned records (`formation_fields::DESIGNATED_PEOPLE`) go back to −1; returns 1
`formation_fields::FORMATION_MASK` = OR of the bits of the 11 slots (`exe::formation_position_to_shape_bit`), with 11 masks swapped for 4 reference formations

Builds the player's strong-position mask from the position ratings and the sides rated 15; returns only `ax`. (cdecl) The mask of the strong positions of player `p` from the position ratings (signed bytes): from 15, going down to 10, the first level at which any rating passes gives the sector bits (`player_sheet::GOALKEEPER` 1, `player_sheet::SWEEPER` 2, `player_sheet::DEFENDER` 4, `player_sheet::DEFENSIVE_MIDFIELDER` 8 or, without it, `player_sheet::ATTACKING_MIDFIELDER` 0x20 or `player_sheet::MIDFIELDER` 0x10, `player_sheet::ATTACKER` 0x40); the sides (`player_sheet::RIGHT_SIDE` 0x800, `player_sheet::LEFT_SIDE` 0x80, `player_sheet::CENTRAL` 0x200) only count with a rating of 15 or more (the original repeats the same test at each level). Returns only `ax` (the callers use 16 bits). Null `p`: as in the original (error box and 0).

Stores the slot coordinate for the phase and ball zone and picks the general and extra positions closest to the slot's 12 coordinates. `Formation::set_slot_coordinate(home, stage, band, coord)` (cell, phase, band, coord): writes the coordinate (dword: x 0..0x1a, y 0..0x23) of the cell for the phase and the ball band (`formation_fields::SLOT_COORDINATES`, 11 × 2 × 3 × 4 dwords) and, for each phase, finds the positions of table 0x9cc368 (words up to 0xffff) closest to the cell's 12 coordinates in that phase (|Δx·9/27| + |Δy·12/36| against each position's cell through `exe::formation_get_default_coordinate`; doubled for positions with bit 2; ties go into the phase's list, up to 11 contiguous at [esp+0x64]). The general position (`formation_fields::SLOT_CELLS`) stays if it is in one of the lists; otherwise it becomes the first of the phase with the smallest distance (`exe::formation_update_shape_code` redoes the mask, the cell gets the flag `formation_fields::DISPLAY_ORDER` and the other cells with the same position lose it). The extra position (`formation_fields::EXTRA_SLOT_CELLS`) comes from the other phase's list: the same position, or one with the same side (`exe::formation_split_position_code`), or the first, or, with two, the middle of the two's bits. Zeroes `formation_fields::CHANGED_FLAG`. Arguments out of range: as in the original (box and 0). Returns 1.

Finds another slot with the same general position and sets the output when its flag is lower. `Formation::check_duplicate_position(home, out)` (cell, *out): zeroes the output; the first other cell with the same general position (`formation_fields::SLOT_CELLS`) decides: with a flag (`formation_fields::DISPLAY_ORDER`, signed byte) lower than the cell's, output 1 and returns 1; otherwise returns 0. With no duplicate, 1. Cell outside 0..10: as in the original (box and 0).

Sets one marking type of the slot (bits 0..2 or 3..4 of byte `formation_fields::MARKING_TYPES`) and clears `formation_fields::CHANGED_FLAG`. `Formation::set_marking_type(home, mark)` (cell, marking): markings 1, 2 and 4 replace bits 0..2 of the cell's byte `formation_fields::MARKING_TYPES`; 8 and 0x10, bits 3..4; it zeroes `formation_fields::CHANGED_FLAG` and returns 1. Any other marking: as in the original (box and 0). The cell is not checked.

Expands each formation slot's positions into the pitch cell tables and their mirrored copy. (thiscall) The formation's cell map. For each of the 22 lines k (11 cells × 2 phases) and 3 × 4 block (a18, a14) with the position (i = 12k + 4·a18 + a14) at `formation_fields::SLOT_COORDINATES` (column, word) and `formation_fields::SLOT_COORDINATES` + 2 (row), the 3 × 3 cells of the block get the column × 9 / 27 in the low nibble and the row × 12 / 36 in the high nibble of table `formation_fields::POSITION_LOOKUP` (12 per row, 9 rows per k); the mirror at `formation_fields::POSITION_LOOKUP` + 0x9b3 (row and column inverted) receives (0xb0 − row × 16) with (0xf8 − column) & 0xf. Returns 1.

Returns the stored cell of the slot by attack and band. The stored cell of slot `slot` 0..10 with `attack` 0/1 and `band` (low word 0..2, high word 0..3): the dword `formation_fields::SLOT_COORDINATES` + 4×(high + 4×(low + 3×(attack + 2×slot))) goes to `*out`. Returns 1. Out of range: as in the original (error box).

Sets a formation flag in `formation_fields::FLAGS`, clearing the others of the same group, and zeroes `formation_fields::CHANGED_FLAG`. Sets flag `m` in `formation_fields::FLAGS`, first clearing those of the same group (1/2/4/8; 0x10/0x20/0x40; 0x80/0x100; 0x200/0x400; 0x800/0x1000; 0x2000/0x4000; 0x8000/0x10000/0x20000) and zeroes `formation_fields::CHANGED_FLAG`. Reads a formation from a .pct file, fixes the instructions of old versions, redoes the positions of the 11 slots from the coordinates and builds the coordinate map. `Formation::load_from_disk(path, quiet, dimmed)`, from the creation of the tactics (0x893dc0: the AI formations and the predefined ones, 45 in a career) and from the tactics screens. Null path (line 0x8d8) or a file that does not open (0x8e0): 0 (without `quiet`, the box). It reads the identifier (4 bytes; byte-swapped if the file's marker `exe::utils_read_file_format_marker` is not the native one; minus 123456789 if obfuscated (`dimmed`)): outside 0x98ec54..0x98ec5e "not a formation" (0x8f7), below 0x98ec59 "old version" (0x900). Then, in order: the password (`formation_fields::PASSWORD`, 50 bytes, each byte inverted, 0xff stays), the creator (`formation_fields::CREATOR`, 200), the mask (`formation_fields::FORMATION_MASK`, from 0x98ec5a; before that 0), the 11 general positions (`formation_fields::SLOT_CELLS`, words) and the mask redone (`exe::formation_update_shape_code`), the display order (`formation_fields::DISPLAY_ORDER`, 11 bytes, from 0x98ec5c; before that zeros), the 11 extra positions (`formation_fields::EXTRA_SLOT_CELLS`), the cells (`formation_fields::SLOT_COORDINATES`, 0x420 bytes = 0x210 words), in versions 0x98ec59/0x98ec5a 0x108 bytes discarded, the team instructions (`formation_fields::FLAGS`, dword), the player instructions (below 0x98ec5e 11 dwords, each with 10 alongside, at +0x188b every 8; after that 0x58 bytes at +0x188b) and the marking types (`formation_fields::MARKING_TYPES`, 11 bytes); the last three, if they fail, only show the box. The team instructions get 0x2000 (without 0x4000) and, below 0x98ec5d, 0x20000. The 11 slots redo their positions from the stored cell (`exe::formation_get_slot_coordinate` and `exe::formation_set_slot_coordinate` with phase 0 and band 0); the name (+0) is the file's (_splitpath `exe::crt_strtok`); the cell map (`exe::formation_build_position_lookup`); `formation_fields::CHANGED_FLAG` = 1, `formation_fields::HAS_PASSWORD` = password not empty, +0x1887 = 1. Closes and returns 1. Non-native files swap the byte order (`exe::swap_bytes_16_array` words, `exe::swap_bytes_32_array` dwords, `exe::swap_bytes_64_array` qwords).

Stores the general or extra position of the slot, the flags, and recomputes the pitch cells without and with the ball (`exe::formation_get_default_coordinate`). `Formation::set_slot_position(home, position, extra)` (cell, position, extra): without `extra`, the cell's general position (`formation_fields::SLOT_CELLS`, words) changes to `position` (if it changes: the mask `exe::formation_update_shape_code`, the cell's flag `formation_fields::DISPLAY_ORDER` = 1 and that of the other cells with the same position = 0); with or without it, the extra position (`formation_fields::EXTRA_SLOT_CELLS`) = `position`. Then, for each band 0..2 and height 0..3 (the low and high word of `exe::formation_get_default_coordinate`'s argument), the pitch cells without and with the ball (`formation_fields::SLOT_COORDINATES` and `formation_fields::SLOT_COORDINATES` + 0x30, + 4 × (height + 4 × band + 24 × cell)): with general = extra, both from the general one; otherwise, by sectors (`exe::formation_split_position_code`): an extra in a sector below the general's gives the extra without the ball and the general with the ball; otherwise the reverse. Finally `formation_fields::CHANGED_FLAG` = 0. Returns 1. Cell outside 0..10: as in the original ("Error" box and 0).

The match engine loop: `n` match instants. Match already decided: quick simulation, standout, closing, humans' instructions restored, referee rating (2). Each instant: punishments, shoot-out, kick-off, drawn substitution, marked incident, restart and taker; on the clock, abandonment (8), period (4) and full time (2 or 4); then possession, each player's time, lines, nearest to the ball, marking and each active player's decision (`decide_player`), with the pending shot and the contest. Validated by the career. Ret 4: the engine loop, `n` instants of the match. Match already decided (+0): quick simulation (`quick_simulation`), standout (`choose_standout`), closing, the humans' instructions restored and the referee rating (`referee_grade`); returns 2. Otherwise clears the player sheets and the pointers of those who left and, at each instant: pending punishments (`FN_CM3_MATCH_ENGINE_PROCESS_QUEUED_FOULS`), penalty shoot-out (`FN_CM3_MATCH_ENGINE_RUN_PENALTY_SHOOTOUT_STEP`; at the end, 2), the narrated kick-off (0x212f/0x1f74), the randomly drawn substitution, the marked incident (`apply_foul`/`clear_move`), the restart (`restart_play`) and the set-piece taker (`exe::cm3_match_engine_pick_restart_taker`). On the clock (`engine::CLOCK`): end by abandonment (8), the period (`period_completed`: 4 at the breaks; end of the match with the aggregate score, `record_tactic_result` and 2 or 4). Ball in play (`roll_ball`) or stopped adds stoppage time; otherwise possession (`FN_CM3_MATCH_ENGINE_RECORD_POSSESSION_TICK`), each player's time (`update_player`), the lines (`defensive_lines`, `store_extremes`, `player_order`), those nearest to the ball, the pressure in the areas (`FN_CM3_MATCH_ENGINE_UPDATE_SIDE_PRESSURE_FLAG`), the marking (`designated_marked`/`FN_CM3_MATCH_ENGINE_CHOOSE_MARKING_TARGET`) and each active player's decision (`decide_player`), with the pending shot (`shot`) and the contest (`FN_CM3_MATCH_ENGINE_RESOLVE_BALL_CHALLENGE`). Returns 1 at the end of the `n` instants.

Lines the teams up for a set piece of side `engine::POSSESSION_SIDE`: counter `engine::SET_PIECES` + 54 × side; releases the ball. Ball in the side's own area: formation (as `line_up_kickoff`) and whoever of the other side lands on the spot moves one row. Otherwise: spot clamped to the grid, far (`engine::SET_PIECE_KIND` = 7) or near (−1), base column 4 − draw + draw, base row 3/4 from the spot; near, everyone from the set-piece table (12 rows × 9 columns per position and kicking side); far, by role (`attacking_role` in attack: 1 deep, 2 middle; `defending_role` in defence: 4 deep, 3 middle). Finally the taker (`exe::cm3_match_engine_pick_restart_taker`, type `engine::RESTART_TYPE`) goes to the spot, takes the ball and aims (`exe::match_player_set_facing_direction`). Cell off the grid: fatal error, as in the original. Details: counter `engine::SET_PIECES` + 54 × side goes up; `engine::POSSESSION_SIDE` = -1; the ball is released (`release_ball`). Ball in the side's own area (row < 3 on side 0, > 8 on side 1): each player goes to his formation cell (as `line_up_kickoff`), and whoever of the other side lands on the ball's spot moves one row; on the kicking side, whoever passed the line goes back one (`exe::match_player_drop_back_one_row`). Otherwise (spot clamped to 0..=8 × 0..=11): far from goal (`engine::SET_PIECE_KIND` = 7) or near (-1); base column 4 - random(2) + random(2) and base row 3 (near) or 4 (far) from the spot towards the goal. Near: everyone from the side's set-piece table (`engine::FORMATION_TABLE`, 12 rows per column, 9 columns per position and kicking side). Far: by role: in attack (`attacking_role`) 1 goes deep and 2 to the middle, in defence (`defending_role`) 4 deep and 3 to the middle, the others from the table. Middle: x 4 ± random, row 6 (side 1) or 5. Deep: x of the base column ± random and row 0..1 or 10..11 next to the attacked or defended goal. Whoever passed the line goes back one (`exe::match_player_drop_back_one_row`). Cell off the grid: the original ends the game (fatal error). At the end the taker (`exe::cm3_match_engine_pick_restart_taker` with type `engine::RESTART_TYPE`) goes to the spot, takes the ball (`take_ball`) and aims (`exe::match_player_set_facing_direction`, 4, 1 on side 1 or 10), with `set_ball_control(200)`. Everyone zeroes +0x2b (`exe::match_player_set_action_delay`).

who kicks off (`engine::GOALKEEPER` side 0, centre 4, 0; `engine::GOALKEEPER_SIDE1` side 1, centre 4, 11); releases the ball (`release_ball`); every player on the pitch goes to his formation cell (table `engine::FORMATION_TABLE` of the direction, byte +0xa2 of the position: x in the low nibble, y in the high one), the defensive lines are redone (`defensive_lines`) and, on the kicking-off side, whoever crossed the line steps back one row (`exe::match_player_drop_back_one_row`); +0x2b is cleared; finally the kicker goes to the centre and takes the ball (`take_ball`), `set_ball_control(200)`, `set_facing(180)` off row 0. Without him: the original (error box). Compared with `lado_a_lado` over the engine from 0x1a0, the grid, the 40 players and the 0xf56e pointers

the list of active players (`position()` ≥ 0) at `engine::ACTIVE_LIST`, count at `engine::ACTIVE_LIST_COUNT`. For each slot 0..20 draws (`exe::utils_random`(2)) which side goes first. Sorts with the CRT `qsort` (`exe::crt_qsort`) and the game's own compare (`action_order`, which reads the engine at `G_ACTION_ORDER_MATCH_ENGINE`)

the order of the 11 takers of each side at `engine::PENALTY_TAKER_ORDER` + 11 × side (−1 first), marking those chosen in each side's 20 slots at `engine::SHOOTOUT_TAKEN` (zeroed first). Side's manager (`engine::SIDE0_MANAGER` + 208 × side) human, with `classification()`, without `exe::human_manager_is_on_holiday` and (with `engine::SIDE0_MANAGER_TACTIC_SLOT`) national team or with `exe::human_manager_controls_reserve_team`: the order comes from the tactics table (`exe::tactics_get_shootout_taker_slot` on `G_TACTICS`). Otherwise, `choose_taker` type 5; with no one, clears the side's marks and repeats the turn

throw-in for side `possession_side()`. Counts (`engine::THROW_INS` + 54 × side), puts the ball (`engine::BALL_X`, `engine::BALL_Y`) inside the pitch, picks the taker (type 2), arranges the 40 players by the formation table (`engine::FORMATION_TABLE`/`engine::FORMATION_TABLE` + 4 by the player's side; index: of the side taking?, position, ball column and row; byte = column + 16 × row) and puts the taker on the ball, facing inwards (90 or 270). With no taker the original shows an error box (no box here) and marks the engine (+0 = 1)

counts (`engine::CORNER_KICKS` + 54 × side), marks the play (`set_piece_kind` = 3, `possession_side` = −1) and arranges the 40: by the attacking role (`attacking_role`, side taking) or defending role (`defending_role`), some go to drawn squares in the box (column 4 ± 1; row 5/6, or drawn 0..1/10..11), the others by the formation table (+0x3b or +0x30). Off the pitch: fatal error. Taker (type 3) at the flag (column 0 or 8 by a draw against `ball_x()`; row 0 or 11)

for each side and active player whose position has marks 0x10 and 4 in the side's table (`position_byte`), finds the direct marker (`exe::cm3_match_engine_find_marking_target`) and stores his record (`staff()`) in the per-position table (`exe::formation_set_marking_target`). who kicks off (`possession_side()`; outside 0..=1, side 0), ball at the centre (4, 5 or 6); every active player goes to their formation square (table 0xf56e + 0x9e for side 0 or 0xf572 + 0xa6 for side 1, 216 bytes per position; low nibble x, high nibble y, clamped to their own half) through `exe::match_player_move_to_grid_cell` and faces forward (`exe::match_player_set_facing_direction`). The players' order on the engine's turn (qsort): the marked ones first, then by strength. Chooses a match referee: the referee range for the competition, a random one in it and the next free one. `OfficialsManager::choose_match_official(game, out)`, from setting up the day (`set_up_the_day`, output at +0x2e of the match). Clears the daily referee busy bytes. `OfficialsManager::clear_busy_flags`, in the day loop (0x5cccd0) and in the run up to the start date (0x5cc850): zeroes the `officials_manager_fields::BUSY_COUNT` busy bytes at `officials_manager_fields::BUSY_FLAGS` (the count and the vector re-read at each step).
