At each league's season start, replaces the referees of its range over 45 (or over 40, one in three) with new random ones and clears the range's statistics rows. `OfficialsManager::renew_officials(comp)`, at the start of each league's season (83 callers). Without a competition, without an object (`G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE`), of types 4 and 2 (`club_sides()`), or without `exe::comp_util_is_league_division`: 0. The competition's range in its nation's block (`nation()`, or a random one), the first that matches, or the whole block. Each referee of the range (0x2b-byte records in `G_OFFICIAL_TABLE`; null record: the "Error" box): over 45 years old (the year as a byte, minus 1 before his birthday), or over 40 and random(3) zero, becomes another: two names from his nation (`exe::database_pick_first_name_for_nation`, `set_first_name` and `set_second_name`), `set_discipline` random(16) + 5 (or, with random(10) zero, random(11) + random(11)), the year (`set_birth_year`) game year − 27 + random(5) and the day (`set_birth_day`) random(340). Then it zeroes the statistics rows (17 bytes at [this]) of each referee of the range (`official_stats::AVERAGE_GRADE`, `official_stats::FOULS`, `official_stats::GRADE_SUM`, `official_stats::MATCHES`, `official_stats::CARDS`; the `add eax, 0x11` at 0x79d149 stays inside the loop). Returns 1 (only al counts).

Reallocates the referee table, generates `count` new referees of the nation and sorts the table by nation and quality. `officials_manager_add_random_officials(count, nation)` (thiscall with this unused, ret 8), from setting up the referees of a new game (`set_up_officials`, in nations with few referees). A nation without a continent (`continent()`): nothing. It reallocates the table (`G_OFFICIAL_TABLE`, `exe::crt_realloc`) to `G_OFFICIAL_COUNT` + count records (out of memory: error and the game stops), generates `count` new records at the end (generate_official: names by weight, random ratings and attributes, born in the 1960s), adds the count to `G_OFFICIAL_COUNT` and sorts the whole table (qsort `exe::crt_qsort` with `officials_manager_compare_nation_then_quality_asc`: nation, +0x28 × 50 + +0x22, id).

Repairs each referee record: the nation from the names, out-of-range ratings and attributes drawn again, and a too-old birth date. `officials_manager_validate_officials()` (cdecl), at the start of setting up the referees of a new game (`set_up_officials`). For each of the `G_OFFICIAL_COUNT` records (0x2b bytes in `G_OFFICIAL_TABLE`): without a nation (`official::NATION`), the one from the nation table by the index (`names::NATION`) of the first name (+4), of the second (+8), or a random one; the words `official::REPUTATION`, `official::CURRENT_ABILITY` and `official::POTENTIAL_ABILITY` outside 1..200: random(80) + 1 plus the nation's byte `nation::REPUTATION` (`official::REPUTATION`) or 4 times it (`official::CURRENT_ABILITY`, `official::POTENTIAL_ABILITY`; the redone `official::POTENTIAL_ABILITY` is at least `official::CURRENT_ABILITY`); the bytes +0x24..+0x2a outside 1..20 drawn by the bands of `official::CURRENT_ABILITY` (above 120, above 80); born before the date `exe::date_date_549f70`(1, 1, 1910, −1) (year unsigned, then the day signed), year 1960 + random(10) and day random(300) + 1.

Copies a 0x2b-byte referee record field by field, the date through the date copy. `Official::operator=(src)`, from setting up the referees of a new game (`set_up_officials`, the records that are kept). Copies the 0x2b-byte record field by field (+0, +4, +8; the date at `official::BIRTH_DAY` through `exe::date_operator_3d`; `official::YEAR_OF_BIRTH`, `official::NATION`, `official::CITY`, +0x1e, +0x20, +0x22, the bytes +0x24..+0x2a). Returns `this`.

Writes the referees and their statistics into the off.dat item of the save. `OfficialsManager::save_official_stats(save)`: writes into the `off.dat` item the number of referees `G_OFFICIAL_COUNT`, the 0x11-byte records from [+0] (one per referee), the number of nations `G_NATION_COUNT`, the 0x102-byte records from `officials_manager_fields::NATION_BLOCKS` (one per nation) and one byte per referee from `officials_manager_fields::BUSY_FLAGS`; returns 1 (in the low byte). No container or an error on opening: the "Error" box (officials_manager.cpp 0x142, 0x14a) and 0; no referees or an error on writing: the box (0x150, 0x156, 0x15c, 0x164, 0x16c, 0x174), it closes the item and 0.

`player_search_record_scouted_club_match(game, result)`, called by the watched match (`player_search_scout_match`) when the list follows a club (+0x190) that plays in it: records the match in the watched club's player histories. `this` is the record of the watched club ([list+0x170]: +0 the club id, 50 slots of 0x1a2 bytes from +4). First the slots of those who left the club are cleared (id −1, the counter +4 and bytes `scouted_player_slot::HISTORY_START`/`scouted_player_slot::HISTORY_COUNT` zeroed); then, on the club's side of the result (`match_record::ROW_STAFF_ID`, 20 records of `match_record_row::SIZE`, the away side at `match_record::SIDE_SIZE`), each player who played (+4 ≠ −1; substitutes beyond the 11th only with a rating, `minute_on()`) gets a line in the 10-match history of his slot (`player_search_find_or_claim_player_slot` with 1; without a slot, the box of line 0x2065): goals, rating, date, opponent, score, competition, the side (`comp_util_get_fixture_venue_side`) and the statistics; the type +0x2e (1 starter, 2 substitute, 5/6 with the rating from `minute_off()`) and the rating +0x15. With the manager of a human club and the attribute masks set, the manager comes to know the player (`exe::fog_of_war_map_raise_knowledge`, which draws).

`PLAYER_SEARCH::contains_player(person)` (SEH frame only for the two local dates, no destructor), called from the human manager's scout list (`is_player_shortlisted`, which the player assessment and the interested clubs consult every day) and from screens: looks the player up in the search results and returns 1 when found and not marked as removed. The local 0x2d-byte key starts with the two default dates (+0x10 and `search_result::LAST_UPDATE_DATE`, `exe::date_date_54a110`); a null person: the box of line 0x33e and 0. Without results (`player_search_fields::RESULT_COUNT` = count): 0. The reference to the person's name in the key (`exe::fill_staff_name_ref`: +0xc the id, the only field the comparison 0x7bce50 reads) and the binary search in the results (`exe::crt_bsearch` with the vector `player_search_fields::RESULTS`, the count, 0x2d and 0x7bce50); found and without the removed flag (`search_result_flags::REMOVED` of `search_result::FLAGS`), 1; otherwise 0.

`player_search_find_or_claim_player_slot(person, reservar)`: returns the player's slot among the 50 of the watched club's record (0x1a2 bytes from +4: +0 the id, −1 free), called by its match (`player_search_record_scouted_club_match`) and by the screens (`find_club_search_entry`). The slot with the person's id; otherwise, with `reservar`, the first free one gets the id (null person: −1), zeroes word +4 and bytes +0x1a0 and +0x1a1 and is returned (none free: the box of line 0x210d and 0); without `reservar`, 0.

`player_search_get_club_target_rating(club, *base, *forced)` (cdecl): the rating the club looks for in players: a base from reputation, money, nation and league, by bands, and adjustments for squad size and wealth; at least 500. The base (without `forced`): the reputation (`reputation()`), the money one (`min_attendance()` × 0.43 − 430, up to 10000, if greater than the reputation), the nation one (`division()`: `competition::REPUTATION` × 500, if greater than reputation / 500) and the league one (`continental_comp_id()` in `G_CLUB_COMP_TABLE`, 0x6b bytes: `reputation()` × 600, likewise), weighted and / 16; half at a non-professional club (`professional_status()` ≠ `professional_status::PROFESSIONAL`). The rating comes from the base by bands (up to 3000, 5000, 7000, 9000 and above). Without `forced`, by the squad (`database_count_club_squad`) and the wealth band of the finances (`exe::financetable_get_club_finance` of `G_FINANCE_TABLE`, `exe::finance_get_wealth_band`) for clubs with a nation in `G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE`: a short squad (< 16) halves; < 20 halves, or 2/3 for the poor; otherwise it shrinks by the shortage of players compared with the nation (`competition::REPUTATION` × 1.35 + 20) and wealth pulls it (−2..2: × 0.909 or − 1000, × 0.952 or − 500, nothing, × 1.0125 or + 125, × 1.025 or + 250). At least 500. The base goes into `*base` (if not null). The floating-point arithmetic is in f64 (the game's x87 at 53 bits).

`PLAYER_SEARCH::get_scout`: returns the search's scout: the index at `player_search_fields::SCOUT_ID` (> −1) in the people vector `G_STAFF_TABLE` (`staff::SIZE` bytes), if it still matches the stored names and date (`exe::database_staff_matches_names` with `player_search_fields::SCOUT_NAME_REF`, `SCOUT_NAME_REF` + 4, `SCOUT_NAME_REF` + 8 and the date at `SCOUT_NAME_REF` + 0x10); otherwise 0.

`PLAYER_SEARCH::set_scout(scout)`: sets a new scout. If the scout changes (the current one through `get_scout`), it stores his ids at `player_search_fields::SCOUT_NAME_REF` (`exe::fill_staff_name_ref`) or, without a scout, the index `player_search_fields::SCOUT_ID` = −1; and the nation (`player_search_fields::ASSIGNED_NATION`), region (`player_search_fields::ASSIGNED_REGION`) and competition (`player_search_fields::ASSIGNED_COMP`) assignments go back to −1. Returns 1.

`PLAYER_SEARCH::get_scout_assignment(club, nation, region, comp, base, opponent)`: with the scout checked, if any assignment is set (club `player_search_fields::ASSIGNED_CLUB`, nation `player_search_fields::ASSIGNED_NATION`, region `player_search_fields::ASSIGNED_REGION` byte, competition `player_search_fields::ASSIGNED_COMP` above −1; base `player_search_fields::ASSIGNED_BASE`, opponent `player_search_fields::ASSIGNED_OPPONENT` non-null), copies the six to the outputs and returns 1; none: 0. A scout that does not check out: the original routine ("Error" box and 0).

`PLAYER_SEARCH::scout_covers_nation(nation)`: tells whether the scout search (type `player_search_fields::LIST_TYPE` = 4) with the scout checked (index `player_search_fields::SCOUT_ID` > −1 and `exe::database_staff_matches_names` with the names `player_search_fields::SCOUT_NAME_REF`..`SCOUT_NAME_REF` + 8 and the date `SCOUT_NAME_REF` + 0x10) and with a club (`staff::CLUB_JOB`) covers `nation`. With an assignment set (`exe::player_search_get_scout_assignment`, which copies the assignments `player_search_fields::ASSIGNED_CLUB`..`player_search_fields::ASSIGNED_OPPONENT` onto themselves): the nation of the assignment's club (`club::NATION` of club `player_search_fields::ASSIGNED_CLUB`), the assignment's nation (`player_search_fields::ASSIGNED_NATION` = id +0 of the nation), the region (`player_search_fields::ASSIGNED_REGION`, signed byte, = `actual_region()` of the nation), or with the base (`player_search_fields::ASSIGNED_BASE`) the same region. Without an assignment: both nations with `group_membership()` = `nation_group::EEC`, the same region (`actual_region()`) as the club's nation, the nation not foreign to the scout (`database_is_staff_foreign` with 1) or the club's scouts covering the nation (`exe::scout_manager_can_club_scout_nation` of `G_SCOUT_MANAGER`). Returns 1 or 0.

Builds the red card ban: the matches or days from the offence code (9 to 12) and the body's scale, today's date and the player; 0 when there is no ban. Ret 0xc: `make_points_ban(r, j, by_games)` (record, player, by matches), from each country's bodies (rb_*.cpp, when processing a match's red card): the offence code (`first_card_offence()` with `yellow_cards()` = 0, `second_card_offence()` with `yellow_cards()` = 1; another type: 0) gives, through the body's scale (+6), the matches (`by_games` ≠ 0; the days stay 0xffff) or the days (the matches stay 0xff) of the ban. In the record: +0 matches, +1 = 0, +2 days, +4 today's date (`G_CURRENT_DATE`, `exe::date_operator_3d`), `ban_record::REASON` = 3, `pending_ban::PERSON_ID` the player's id (+0), +0x6f = (+0x48 of the player == 0). Returns 1; with no ban, 0 without writing anything.

At the new season, releases bans 2 (or 4) years old, frees the entries without a ban, clears the bookings of the others and compacts the table. Ret 0: `RulingBody::start_new_season()`: for each occupied disciplinary entry (14 bytes in `ruling_body::ENTRIES`, count `ruling_body::ENTRY_COUNT`; id −1 is a free slot): with a ban (+6, signed index into the 20-byte discipline table `[[G_DISCIPLINE]+4]`) 2 or more years old (4 if the body has neither `ruling_body::NATION_ID` nor `ruling_body::CONTINENT_ID`; the ban year in +6 against today's `G_CURRENT_DATE_YEAR`), releases the ban (`release_ban`) and frees the entry; without a ban, frees the entry; otherwise zeroes the bookings (+4, +5, +8 and the low 6 bits of `ruling_body_entry::SEASON_FLAGS`). Freeing: the player's stored slot in the body (`find_held_ban` through slot +4) with the same +5 gets −1 in +6; without it, writes the slot (`discipline_set_slot`, type +5, −1); the entry's id becomes −1. At the end compacts the entries (`compact_entries`, in this batch).

Removes the free entries from the body's discipline table, fixes the stored index of each moved player and reallocates with 100 spare rows. Ret 0: `RulingBody::compact_entries()`: removes the free entries (id −1) from the 14-byte table `ruling_body::ENTRIES`, bringing the occupied ones to the front; each one that moves fixes the player's stored index (`find_held_ban` through slot +4: with the same +5, the new index in +6; without it, `discipline_set_slot` with type +5 and the index). Count `ruling_body::ENTRY_COUNT` = n, capacity `ruling_body::ENTRY_CAPACITY` = n + 100 and reallocates (`exe::crt_realloc`) with (n + 100) × 14 bytes; out of memory, the box (line 0x594) and continues.

`load_game_data(path)` (cdecl, ~14.6 KB, SEH): loads the whole saved game. Returns 1 if it loaded. Disk (`exe::os_get_free_disk_space_mb`(0) < 25 sets `G_GAME_IN_PROGRESS_FLAG`) and memory (`G_MEMORY_CHECK_ENABLED` and `exe::os_get_free_memory_mb`() < 50 set `G_GAME_SESSION_STARTED_FLAG`); the temporary folder (`exe::utils_build_file_path` "CM3_TEMP"); the CD (`check_game_cd`); a null `path` gives the "Error" box 0x233b. The database: `exe::database_free_all_tables` if `G_NATION_TABLE` ≠ 0 and `load_database_from_stream`(path, 1) (the answer is not looked at). "Loading game data" and the progress bar `exe::screenmanager_send_network_status_message` (step 0x2d); clears the `*.tmp` files (`utils_clear_temp_folder`), checks their space (`zget_matching_size`, in MB, 0 becomes 25) against the disk, unpacks (`zextract_matching_files`; on failure: "Disk Space Error" 0x2382). `general.dat` (`exe::zopen` reading, 0x15, type 4; without it: "Load Game Error" 0x2397): the version (`G_GAME_DATA_VERSION`); the summary (|v| ≥ 0x3e023; 0xf70 bytes up to 0x3e026 with the play time zeroed, 0xf74 after that, with `G_GAME_PLAY_TIME_TOTAL` = its play time); `G_GAME_PLAY_TIME_LAST_STAMP` = time(); the unique id, the database size, the dates and times (the game's in a local), the leagues, the default nation (`G_MAIN_NATION` = nation id, or 0 if < 0), the runtime data of people (`G_STAFF_STATE_TABLE`, 0x4f × `G_STAFF_STATE_COUNT`; old saves converted by `convert_staff_state`; |v| < 0x3e018 clears bit 7 of `staff_state::STATUS_FLAGS` of the first `G_STAFF_COUNT`), of clubs (`G_CLUB_STATE_TABLE`, 6 × `G_CLUB_STATE_COUNT` = `G_CLUB_COUNT`; |v| < 0x3e022: −1, 0, 0) and the reputation (`G_CLUB_REPUTATION_ORDER`, 4 × `G_CLUB_COUNT`; |v| < 0x3e022 does not read it and calls `database_sort_clubs_by_reputation`(1)). A failed read: "Load Game Error" with the line and the field's text, item closed; without memory: "Error" and the game closes. Steps 4..=0x2d (`LOAD_STEPS`, disk and memory checked before each): at step 5, the game date (`exe::date_operator_3d` into `G_CURRENT_DATE`); before step 9, the last 16 managers with +0x5f = 5 are undone (News, HUMAN_MANAGER, CONTRACT_MANAGER, NationalTeams, Staff_Records; empty names, date 1/0/1966, +0x24 and +0x39 = 0, `exe::screenmanager_remove_manager_record`); after 0x22, `exe::reservecomp_create_sub_comps`; before the last one, |v| < 0x3e032 passes each person through `staff_normalise_player_attributes`. FIFA rules (`load_fifa_transfer_rules`, |v| ≥ 0x3e039); `G_LAST_AUTOSAVE_DATE` = the game date; `G_GAME_DATA_LOADED_FLAG` = `G_GAME_HAS_SAVE_FILE_FLAG` = 1, `G_GAME_UNSAVED_CHANGES_FLAG` = 0; with `G_FIFA_TRANSFER_RULES_FEATURE_ENABLED`, it switches the rules on or off by the date of `G_TRANSFER_RULE_CHANGE_DATE` (`exe::news_post_transfer_system_change`(1) when switching on); without `auto_setup.cfg`, the CD search at the end. The original's branches for 0x3e042 ≤ |v| < 0x3e038 (0xd-byte records) and 0x3e042 ≤ |v| < 0x3e034 (0xc) are unreachable (the comparisons are chained with `jge`): they are left out. The original's two-pass loop ([esp+0x24]; the 1st only sets the total 0x2d) runs the body once.

`create_game_from_setup_file(cfg, qst)` (cdecl, ~3 KB): reads the configuration file `cfg` (`auto_setup.cfg` or `quick_start.cfg`: database, stats, foreground and background leagues, language, engine, bids, holiday), creates the game and, with `qst`, saves the quick start `CM3_QSTART\<qst>.qst` and frees everything; without `qst`, puts the human manager on holiday at a drawn club. Returns 1 if it created the game. Folders CM3_TEMP (`exe::utils_build_file_path`, only copied, as in the original) and CM3_DATA. A null `cfg` or one that does not open (`exe::crt_fopen` "r"): the "Error" box (0x1c13, 0x1c1b) and 0. Each line (`exe::utils_read_config_line`, 1000-byte buffer) goes through `exe::utils_trim_control_chars` and loses its spaces (one by one, like the original's `strcpy`); the value is searched for with `strstr` (`exe::crt_strstr`) after the prefix: `DATABASE=` NORMAL/MINIMUM/MAXIMUM → `exe::config_set_option`(1/2/4) in `G_CONFIG`; `MATCH_STATS=` NORMAL/SMALL/LARGE → 0x200/0x400/0x800; `FOREGROUND_LEAGUES=` and `BACKGROUND_LEAGUES=`: on the first one, without a database (`G_NATION_TABLE` = 0), it loads the database (`exe::load_database_from_files`, CM3_DATA; a failure stops the game), applies it (`exe::config_apply_and_save`), zeroes byte `nation::LEAGUE_SELECTED` of the nations, `G_NATIONS_TO_LOAD_COUNT`, `G_SELECTED_NATION_COUNT` (and `G_MAIN_NATION` for the foreground) and builds the key nations (`exe::key_nation_build_table`; a failure stops the game); then, for each league in the table 0xb63d60 (0x23 of 0x48 bytes) with a nation and +8, if the name (`nation_get_english_three_letter_name`) is on the line or `exe::nation_matches_region_filter` accepts it: foreground, flag 0/1 → ((~options & 2) | 1) << 1 and counts (+`G_NATIONS_TO_LOAD_COUNT` only from 0, +`G_SELECTED_NATION_COUNT`) and the 1st that matches by `strncmp` (`exe::crt_strncmp`) or `exe::nation_matches_region_filter` becomes `G_MAIN_NATION`; background, 0 → ((~options & 2) << 1) | 1 (+`G_NATIONS_TO_LOAD_COUNT`) and 2 → the same (−`G_SELECTED_NATION_COUNT`); `LANGUAGE=`: the 1st language i (table 0x9eb244, 19) that exists (`exe::langlib_is_language_available`), is English, there is no database or the database has it (`database_language_file_exists`), and is on the line: `exe::config_set_language`(i) and `exe::config_apply_and_save`; `ENABLE_MATCH_ENGINE=` YES/NO → byte `G_MATCH_ENGINE_ENABLED`; `ENABLE_COMPUTER_BIDS=` → `G_COMPUTER_BIDS_ENABLED`; `ON_HOLIDAY=` → the manager's holiday. Closes the file; with no league flagged, no foreground league, no default nation or one without bit 2: 0. `G_NEW_GAME_SETUP_DONE_FLAG` = `G_SETUP_FILE_GAME_FLAG` = 1; creates the game (`exe::create_game`(qst ≠ 0); a failure stops the game). With `qst`: `exe::crt_makepath` (CM3_QSTART, `qst`, ".qst"), `save_game_data`(path, 0x17), `free_game_data`(1) and 1. Without it: "auto_setup_game" in `G_CONFIG` + `config::SAVE_NAME`, `G_GAME_HAS_SAVE_FILE_FLAG` = 1, the date in `G_LAST_AUTOSAVE_DATE`; if the current human (`G_SCREEN_RECORDS_MANAGER` + 0x300 × (i16)`G_SCREEN_MANAGER_CURRENT_SLOT`) already has a person, 0. Otherwise, the 1st of the last 16 people (`G_STAFF_TABLE`, 0x6e) with `staff::CLASSIFICATION` = 0 (without a table, box 0x39b3 and person 0) becomes the human: text `staff::COMMON_NAME` zeroed, date `staff::DATE_OF_BIRTH` (`exe::date_set`: 1, 0, 1966, −1), `staff::YEAR_OF_BIRTH` = 1966, `staff::NATIONAL_JOB` and `staff::CLUB_JOB` = 0, `staff::CLASSIFICATION` = 1, `exe::human_manager_reset_human_record` and `exe::human_manager_set_on_holiday`(holiday, 0) on `G_HUMAN_MANAGER`; it draws (`exe::utils_random`) clubs (`G_CLUB_TABLE`, `club::SIZE`) until one that is not a national side (`exe::database_is_national_team`), with a nation of a foreground league (bit 2) and accepted by `club_can_be_managed`: its nation into `staff::NATION`, the names (`exe::database_pick_first_name_for_nation`, `exe::database_pick_second_name_for_nation`) into `staff::FIRST_NAME` and `staff::SECOND_NAME`, and `exe::appoint_human_manager_to_club`(person, club). Returns 1.

`save_game_data(path, a4)` (cdecl, ~6.8 KB, SEH): saves the whole game into the container `path` (a4 0x16 `.sav`, 0x17 `.qst`; type 3 with bit 0x8000 of `game.cfg` [`G_CONFIG`+4], otherwise 4 = RLE): the database, general.dat, the subsystem saves in the original order with disk and memory checks between them, the packed *.tmp files and the FIFA rules; on a network game it writes to temp_save_file and renames. Returns 1 if it saved. `G_GAME_DATA_VERSION` = 0xfffc1fb9 (the save version). On a network game (bit 0x20000000), before anything, disk (`exe::os_get_free_disk_space_mb`(0) < 25) sets `G_GAME_IN_PROGRESS_FLAG` and memory (`G_MEMORY_CHECK_ENABLED` and `exe::os_get_free_memory_mb`() < 1) sets `G_GAME_SESSION_STARTED_FLAG`: deletes `path` and returns 0. Temporary folder (`exe::utils_build_file_path` "CM3_TEMP"); a null `path` gives the "Error" box (0x2958). The working path is `path` or, on a network game, the same with the name `temp_save_file` (`exe::crt_strtok`/`exe::crt_makepath`); if it already exists (`exe::utils_file_exists`) and cannot be removed (`exe::crt_remove` = −1), returns 0. With bit 0x40000000, disk and memory again (deleting `path`). `save_database_for_game` (the database, step 1 of the save); disk and memory (deleting the working path); the translated "Saving game data" and the progress bar `exe::screenmanager_send_network_status_message` (step 1 of 0x25). `general.dat` (`exe::zopen`): 16 fields (the version, the 0xf74-byte summary `build_save_game_summary`, the unique id, the database size, the dates and times, the leagues, the default nation or −1, the runtime data of people, clubs and reputation); a write error gives the "Disk Space Error" box with the field's line and closes the item. Steps 2..=0x24 (`SAVE_STEPS`): disk and memory (before 0x11, without deleting and with memory < 25), the progress bar and the subsystem's `save`; 0x25: packs the `*.tmp` files (`zadd_matching_files`). Hall of fame (`exe::halloffame_save`, outside the save), FIFA rules (`save_fifa_transfer_rules`); on a network game, swaps the old save for the new one (`exe::crt_rename`); `G_GAME_HAS_SAVE_FILE_FLAG` = 1, `G_GAME_UNSAVED_CHANGES_FLAG` = 0 and the date of the last save (`G_LAST_AUTOSAVE_DATE`). The original's local date ([esp+0x1758], `exe::date_date_54a110`, empty destructor 0x5a53c0 in the SEH) is not used: it is left out. The original's loop ([esp+0x11c] from 1 to 2) runs the body once, with the total 0x25. The summary is a zeroed buffer here; in the original, what `build_save_game_summary` does not write (the club of the 16 non-human managers, the rest of the texts) is leftover from its stack, saved into `general.dat`.

`valid_saved_game_version(path)` (cdecl): opens the container's `general.dat` item, reads the version and the summary and returns 1 if the summary's version text is the exe's. Opens the item (`exe::zopen` reading, a4 0x15, type 4), reads the saved version (4 bytes) and the save summary (0xf70 bytes if |version| < 0x3e027, otherwise 0xf74) and returns 1 if the summary's version text (+0x7d0) equals the exe's (`exe::utils_get_version_string`), otherwise 0. Each failed read gives the "Load Game Error" box (Setup.cpp 0x3a36, 0x3a3d, 0x3a48, 0x3a55) and 0. As in the original, on success the item is NOT closed (the ZFILE and the file stay open). The original's SEH frame only protects the local date (`exe::date_date_54a110`, no destructor), which falls inside the summary (`save_summary::GAME_DATE`) and is overwritten by the read.

`save_fifa_transfer_rules(save)` (cdecl): writes the last item of the save, `fifa_transfer_rules.zip`: 2 bytes, `G_FIFA_TRANSFER_RULES_IN_FORCE` and the rule in force `G_MAX_CONTRACT_LENGTH_YEARS`, then `zclose`. A null path, an item that does not open or a failed write: the "Error" box (Setup.cpp 0x3b24, 0x3b2c, 0x3b32, 0x3b38); on the writes, the item is closed after the box. The original returns nothing (`eax` is leftover).

`load_fifa_transfer_rules(save)` (cdecl): reads the 2 bytes of the `fifa_transfer_rules.zip` item (`exe::zopen` reading) into `G_FIFA_TRANSFER_RULES_IN_FORCE` and `G_MAX_CONTRACT_LENGTH_YEARS`; if `G_FIFA_TRANSFER_RULES_IN_FORCE` = 1, the rule in force `G_MAX_CONTRACT_LENGTH_YEARS` becomes 5. Closes the item. Errors: the "Error" box (Setup.cpp 0x3b4f, 0x3b57, 0x3b5d, 0x3b63), as in the save.

`free_game_data(screen)` (cdecl): releases the screens and destroys the subsystems held in globals, in the original order; returns 1. The screen manager (`G_SCREEN_MANAGER`) releases the screens (`exe::screenmanager_end_network_session`) and, if `screen` ≠ 0, also `exe::screenmanager_close_all_screens`; `free_event_tables`; then each subsystem kept in a global, in the original's order: destructor (thiscall) + `delete` (`exe::crt_operator_delete`) and the global zeroed; the loose vectors through `free` (`exe::crt_free`); two objects through the virtual destructor (vtable[0](1)); the `*.tmp` files of the temporary folder (`exe::utils_clear_temp_folder`), `G_NATION_NAME_INDEX_TABLE`, the database tables (`exe::database_free_all_tables`), the game date (`exe::date_set`: 1, 0, 2001, −1) and three flags zeroed.

the Holland rule (12): one window, from 8 June (moved to the Saturday [inference]) to 4 April (moved to the Friday [inference]); `transfer_rules::FOREIGN_PLAYER_LIMIT` = 50 (base default 50) [inference: the foreign limit]; `transfer_rules::NON_EU_PLAYER_LIMIT` = 50 (default 30)

Decides whether an Italian loan is allowed: refuses outside the first two windows (9) and, in the five listed divisions, with four players on loan from other clubs (0x25). `ITALY_RULES::can_loan_player(club, _player, msg, reason)`: outside the first two windows (`exe::transfer_window_contains_date` with `[this+4]` and `[this+4]` + 0xc): reason 9. A club of one of the five divisions (`KEY_CLUB_COMP_ITALIAN_SERIE_C1_A` to `KEY_CLUB_COMP_ITALIAN_SERIE_C2_C`) with four players on loan from other clubs (ids below `G_STAFF_COUNT`, loan contract `exe::contract_manager_get_loan_contract`) may not (0x25).

Constructs the Poland transfer rules (rule 18): one window, from 1 July to 20 February; `transfer_rules::FOREIGN_PLAYER_LIMIT` = 5 (base default 50) [inference: the foreign player limit]; `transfer_rules::NON_EU_PLAYER_LIMIT` = 5 (default 30). Ret 0x14, `POLAND_RULES::POLAND_RULES`; SEH frame only for the `new`, no destructor on the normal path: the base (`exe::new_transfer_rules`), vtable 0x96e61c, 1 window from `POLAND_TRANSFER_WINDOWS`; `transfer_rules::FOREIGN_PLAYER_LIMIT` = 5 (the base default is 50) [inference: the foreign player limit]; `transfer_rules::NON_EU_PLAYER_LIMIT` = 5 (the default is 30). Returns the object.

Adds a transfer offer: puts the offer in an array slot (the stored one, the same buyer's for the same target or the first empty one; grows by 50 when full), copies the fields, gives the serial number, links rival offers for the player, schedules the answer (28 days with a human, otherwise the reply deadline) and posts the news. Ret 8; SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path (only the `new` of the offer and of the lists): `TRANSFER_MANAGER::add_transfer_offer(offer, terms)`. The lowest stored free slot (`lowest_free_slot()`) is read and set back to −1; an offer with no fee (`fee()` = 0) loses `instalments()`. Vector full (`offer_count()` = `offer_capacity()`): grows by 50 (calloc `exe::crt_calloc` the first time, otherwise realloc `exe::crt_realloc` with the 50 new ones zeroed; out of memory, the box (line 0x4d2) and the game ends). The slot (`find_offer_slot_and_rival`); none: the "Error" box (line 0x511) and nothing. The slot's old offer is removed (`remove_offer`); a new one (`exe::crt_operator_new` of 0x41 bytes, `exe::new_transfer_offer`) receives a copy of the fields (the date `offer::DUE_DATE` through `exe::date_operator_3d`, the low nibble of `offer::COMPLETION_TIMING` and of `offer::OFFER_KIND`), the slot index (`offer::SLOT_INDEX`, also in the incoming offer), `offer::NEGOTIATION_INDEX` = −1, `offer::STATUS` and `offer::TERMS_STATE` zeroed, `offer::PLAYER_AWARE` 2 becomes 1, and the serial number (`offer::SERIAL` = `next_serial()`, which goes up; also in the incoming one). With an exchange (`exchange_players()`), a new list (`exe::new_llist`) with a copy of the exchange (`exe::llist_copy_from`). With a rival, the slot joins the rival's list of offers for the player (+0, `exe::llist_add_tail`), or a new one with the rival and it. The deadline: with `pre_contract()`, status 7 and 28 days if the buyer is human (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club` with 0, 1, 0, 0), otherwise nothing; without `pre_contract()`, 28 days if the seller (the club of the target's contract) is human, otherwise the reply deadline (`get_offer_response_delay`), scheduled (`schedule_offer`) if it gives days or slices. The news: loan offered (`post_loan_offer_news` with the terms) or offer made (`post_offer_made_news`). The target's 8-byte record (`person_flags()`): bit 0 of +0 and `person_transfer_record::OFFER_COUNT` goes up; +2 of each exchange player goes up. A human buyer and a target with a player sheet (`player()`): `exe::scout_manager_add_to_shortlist` (`G_SCOUT_MANAGER`, target, 0).

Screens only: the club accepts the loan request; the contract decision, the news, and without agreement status 0xf, the shortlists, the 10-day scheduling and bit 0 of the player record. Ret 8: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::accept_loan_offer(slot, mark)`, only from the transfer screen (0x8ef1e0) and the news (`exe::newsitem_auto_respond`). With `mark`, `offer::PLAYER_AWARE` = 1. The contract decision (`schedule_decision_for_transfer` on `G_CONTRACT_MANAGER`), status 8 and the offer-accepted news (`post_offer_accepted_news`); decision 0: nothing more. Otherwise the refusal-to-move news (`post_player_rejects_move_news` with 0), status 0xf with `offer::RESPONSE_ROUND` = 3, the player leaves the buyer's scouting lists (`clear_bid_markers_for_player`) and each exchange player those of the seller (the club of the player's contract), and the offer is scheduled for 10 days (`schedule_offer`). If it and all offers for the player (+0) are settled (`is_offer_settled`), bit 0 of the player's 8-byte record (`person_flags()`) is cleared.

Handles a player accepting terms: marks the agreement of the target (or the exchange player); outside loans, the reply news and the offer follow-up; for loans, a squad above 50 or the nation rule refuse, otherwise completes at once (contract, history, numbers, record, status 0x14 in 5 days). Ret 0x14; SEH frame for the local date, without a destructor: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::handle_player_accepted_terms(person, slot, contract, kind, news)`, from the acceptance of a contract (0x4cf413). Slot outside the vector: the "Error" box (0xe0c, 0xe11) and nothing; empty slot: nothing. `response_round` is zeroed. The offer's target accepted: `terms_state` = `terms_state::ACCEPTED` and `job_type` = `kind`; A = the buyer, B = the club of the target's contract (type 5 does not count). Otherwise the person is an exchange player: his node in the exchange (`exchange_players()`) gets 2 and the type (+4, +6); A = the club of the target's contract, B = the buyer (no exchange: box 0xe4d; without the node, nothing found: A and B the original leaves without a value, the copy uses 0). Outside a loan (`offer_type()` ≠ 1): the reply news (`exe::transfer_manager_post_contract_response_news` with A, B, 2 and the offer) and the offer follow-up (`advance_offer_to_club_approval`). On a loan: A's squad (`database_count_club_squad`) + 1 above 50, reason 4; otherwise the rule of A's nation (`club::NATION`) answers (vtable `transfer_rules_vtable::CAN_LOAN_PLAYER` with the buyer and the target) with the reason. With a reason: the refusal (`exe::transfer_manager_post_loan_cancelled_news`), status `offer_status::CANCELLED`, the end (`transfer_manager_close_offer_contract_offers`), the target leaves the buyer's lists and the exchange players those of the club of the target's contract (`clear_bid_markers_for_player`), 5 days (`schedule_offer`) and the mark (`clear_under_offer_mark`). Without a reason, the loan happens at once: the terms (`exe::transfer_manager_post_loan_accepted_news`), the rule of the buyer's nation (vtable +8, or +4 outside a loan), the signed contract (`sign_loan_contract`), the person's `squad_selected_for()` `euro_registration::REGISTERED` becomes `euro_registration::REGISTERED_ON_LOAN`, the history (`add_loan_records`), the scouting list (`is_on_shortlist`/`update_staff_status` with 5), `hold_bans_for_loan`, the numbers (`set_squad_number`, `staff_set_squad_flags`, `club_uses_squad_numbers`/`allocate_squad_number`), `clear_awol`, the record of the past transfer (`add_past_transfer`: the person, the `names::ID` of its `first_name()`, `second_name()` and `common_name()`, the ids of A and B, 0, 2 and today), status `offer_status::COMPLETED` with 5 days, the mark, the end (`transfer_manager_close_offer_contract_offers`) and the person out of the lists (`suspend_clubs_shortlisting_player` with 1).

The computer seller answers a bid: loan bids are refused without looking at anything else; unless a rule makes it accept, the floor fee and the other offers, the exchange value, the cash, exchange and clause options; an option worth less than the bid / 0.85 accepts, the best one under the bid / 0.75 becomes a counter offer, otherwise refuses. Ret 8; SEH frame without a destructor (the slot's local date): `TRANSFER_MANAGER::ai_respond_to_bid(slot, dry_run)`, the computer seller club's answer to a bid. The target is `target_staff_id()` of the offer, the buyer `buyer_club_id()` and the seller the club of the target's contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`, in `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`; except type 5). 
 - Target without a player sheet (`player()`): status `offer_status::CANCELLED` and the offer in the next slice (`schedule_offer`: push 0; push 1; push offer). 
 - Loan bid (`offer_type()` = 1): refused without looking at anything else (`reject_loan_offer`: push 0; push 0; push slot), outside the dry run. 
 - The seller must accept (`transfer_manager_selling_club_must_accept`, stdcall(offer, 0, 0)): accepted (`accept_transfer_bid`: push 0; push slot), outside the dry run. 
 - Human seller (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club` with 1, 1) with a manager (`exe::database_get_club_manager`) who answers (`FN_HUMAN_MANAGER_IS_ON_HOLIDAY` on `G_HUMAN_MANAGER`): his rule 0 (`exe::human_manager_get_holiday_option`: push manager; push 0) with an exchange, or equal to 1: refusal (`reject_transfer_offer`: push 0; push 0; push slot). 
 - The floor (`exe::contract_manager_calc_asking_price`: push 1; push 1; push &reason; push target; push buyer; push seller; mov ecx, `G_CONTRACT_MANAGER`) and, outside the dry run, the other offers of list +0 that are not active: their value (`exe::transfer_offer_get_weighted_value` with 0, 0, 1, 0, 1) above the floor becomes the floor and zeroes the reason. The total (`exe::transfer_offer_get_total_value` with 1, 0, 0, 1), the asking price (`exe::transfer_offer_get_weighted_value` with 0, 0, 1, 1, 1) and the value k (`exe::transfer_offer_get_weighted_value` with 0, 1, 1, 1, 1). Each exchange player (`exchange_players()`): the position word (`position_mask`: the first bit of 1, 2, 4, 0x10, 8; otherwise 0x20 or 0x40) in the local slot, his value for the seller (`value_player_for_club` with −1, 0) up to floor − k and, outside the dry run, if the seller does not accept him (`exe::shortlist_manager_club_wants_player` with 1) the exchange is refused. The price is the larger of floor and k. 
 - The options (cash `build_cash_offer_option`, exchange `make_exchange_option`, clause `build_clause_offer_option`): with none, refusal with the reason (`reject_transfer_offer` with 1). The most attractive one is the best; the first whose value (`exe::transfer_offer_get_weighted_value` with 0, 0, 1, 1, 1) × 0.85 is below the asking price, with no refused exchange: accepted (outside the dry run). No best: the box (line 0x1eee) and the refusal, without freeing the options. 
 - Otherwise: the best one's value (`exe::transfer_offer_get_weighted_value` with 0, 0, 0, 0, 1) × 0.75 below the asking price, type (`offer_kind()` & 0xf) not 1 or 2 and outside the dry run: the counter offer (the low nibble of `offer::COMPLETION_TIMING` of the offer into the best one and `add_transfer_negotiation`: push 0; push best; push offer). Otherwise the refusal (`reject_transfer_offer` with 1), with reason 10 if the total was below 0.55 of the target's value (`value()`) with a 2 million difference, or below 0.1 with 100 thousand (outside the dry run). The options are destroyed (`exe::drop_transfer_offer`) and freed.

Screens only: the offer copy without its lists, with the contract built from the new loan terms, becomes a negotiation; returns the copy's index. Ret 0x14; SEH frame for the local offer: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::add_loan_negotiation(o, a2, a3, a4, a5)`, only from the transfer screen (0x8fb5e0). A local STAFF_CONTRACT (`construct_staff_contract`) and a local offer (`exe::new_transfer_offer`) with the offer's fields (the date `offer::DUE_DATE` through `exe::date_operator_3d`; the low nibble of `completion_timing` and of `offer_kind`; lists +0 and `exchange_players` empty); the contract from the current one (`init_from_current_contract`: push a5; push a4; push a3; push a2; push club `buyer_club_id()`; push target `target_staff_id()`; lea ecx, contract) goes into the list at `loan_negotiations()` (created if missing: `exe::crt_operator_new` of 0xe bytes and `exe::new_llist`; `exe::llist_add_tail` with 0x50 bytes) and the copy becomes a negotiation (`add_transfer_negotiation`: push 0; push © push offer). Returns `slot_index()` of the copy (the index); the copy is destroyed (`exe::drop_transfer_offer`).

Builds the exchange option: a new offer at the price with attraction 50; for the target and the 25 slots of the seller's shortlist, buyer players in the same position, free of offers and exchanges, with interest of at least 3.15 and rating above 0.9 of the candidate's join the exchange (up to 3): attraction rises 20 or 5 and their value leaves the price. Ret 0x18; SEH frame for the local LLIST: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::make_exchange_option(buyer, target, offer, out, attraction, value)`, the exchange option of the AI's answer to a bid (`ai_respond_to_bid`). The seller is the club of the target's contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`, in `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`); the local LLIST (`exe::new_llist`/`exe::drop_llist`). The target's contract with the seller (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract_for_club`). Without the seller's scouting list (byte `club_shortlist::ACTIVE` of the 9-byte record in `[shortlist_manager() + shortlist_manager_fields::CLUB_SHORTLISTS]`): 0. Otherwise the buyer's squad (`database_collect_club_squad` with 0: 50 slots), the new offer (`exe::crt_operator_new` of 0x41 bytes and `exe::new_transfer_offer`) in *out, prepared (`exe::transfer_offer_init_transfer_offer`: push value; push buyer; push target; mov ecx, offer), attraction 50, `fee` = value and the ceiling = value × 1.1 (_ftol). For the target (slot −1, except a contract with status 7) and the 25 slots of the seller's list (`shortlist_slot::TARGET_STAFF_ID`, excluding the seller's own players), while the exchange does not have 3: the position (`position_mask`), the flags (0x4800, or 0x4900 outside status 2 and 3; outside 5, | 0x80 and the range) and the base rating. Then the target himself and the 50 of the squad with the same position: a contract with the candidate's current club (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract_for_club`) of a type other than 5, at the buyer, without a sheet (`FN_CONTRACT_MANAGER_GET_LOAN_CONTRACT`), without bits 0x30 of `staff_state::STATUS_FLAGS` of the 79-byte record, floor (`exe::contract_manager_calc_asking_price` with 0, 1, 1) up to the ceiling; with no offer (`get_offers_for_player`), exchange (`get_exchange_offers_for_player` in the local list) or exchange negotiation of the target (`get_exchange_negotiations_for_player`), or only this offer's exchange (`slot_index()`); the seller can reach him (`can_club_bid_for_player` with 0, 1); interest (`staff_interest_in_joining_club`: push 0; push status; push 0; push 1; push seller; push player; mov ecx, `shortlist_manager()`) of at least 3.15; his rating / the base above 0.9: the attraction rises 20 (higher rating) or 5, between 0 and 100; not yet in the exchange (`exchange_players()`, created if missing), he joins it (`exe::llist_add_tail` with 7 bytes: id, 0, status), his value (`value_player_for_club` with −1, 1) is taken off the ceiling and off `fee()` (at least 0), and the slot ends. Returns 1.

The seller accepts the bid: status 5; on loans, target interest below 0.75 gives the refusal to move; exchange players wanting more than 1.5 times the seller's wage cap leave, with their value added to the fee; the offer goes to the next slice. Ret 8; SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path (the local STAFF_CONTRACT of `construct_staff_contract`): `TRANSFER_MANAGER::accept_transfer_bid(slot, mark)`, the selling club accepts the bid. The target is `target_staff_id()`, the buyer `buyer_club_id()` and the seller the club of the target's contract (except type 5). `response_round` = 0; with `mark`, `player_aware` = 1 and the player marked as under offer in the scouting list (`mark_player_under_offer`: push +0 of the offer; push buyer; push target; mov ecx, `shortlist_manager()` -> thiscall, ret 0xc). `response_round` = 0, status 5 (`offer_status::ACCEPTED`); the count of human managers (`news_club_has_human_manager`, stdcall: ecx = `G_NEWS` is not read) between buyer and seller; the acceptance news (`post_offer_accepted_news`). 
 - Loan (`job_type()` = `job_kind::PLAYER`): the status the buyer would give (1 if human; otherwise `get_squad_status_for_club`: push 0; push buyer; push target, ret 0xc) goes in the low byte of the `mark` dword, and the target's interest (`staff_interest_in_joining_club`: push &reason; push that dword; push 0; push 0; push buyer; push target; mov ecx, `shortlist_manager()` -> thiscall, ret 0x18, returns ST0) below 0.75 (or NaN): the refusal to move (`post_player_rejects_move_news`: push reason; push offer, ret 8), status 0xf (`offer_status::COLLAPSED`), `response_round` = 3, the bids unmarked (`clear_bid_markers_for_player`), 10 days (`schedule_offer`), with the offer active and closed together with those of list +0 (`transfer_offer_closed`, stdcall) bit 0 of the target's 8-byte record in `person_flags()` cleared, and the status in the scouting list (`exe::shortlist_manager_find_club_shortlist_entry`: push 0; push type ≠ 0xb; push target; push buyer, ret 0x10; found, `update_staff_status`: push the dword with the low byte = role ≠ 0xb and the high bytes from the entry pointer; push 1; push buyer; push target, ret 0x10). End. 
 - Otherwise, each exchange player (`exchange_players()`): human seller, +5 = 2; his desired contract (`exe::staff_contract_set_to_desired_contract`: push 0; push 0; push 0xb; push +5 (only the byte is read); push −1; push seller; push person; lea ecx, contract -> thiscall, ret 0x1c) and the seller's wage cap (`get_club_finance`: push seller; mov ecx, `G_FINANCE_TABLE`, ret 4; `get_max_wage`: push +5; push person; mov ecx, finances, ret 8): cap × 1.5 below the wage, he leaves the exchange: his value (`calc_player_value`: push 0; push −1; push 0; push buyer; push person; mov ecx, `G_CONTRACT_MANAGER`, ret 0x14) is added to `fee()`, the news (`exe::transfer_manager_post_swap_player_rejects_news`: push value; push person; push offer, ret 0xc), removal from the list (`manager_manager_remove`: push node; mov ecx, list, ret 4), byte +2 of his record in `person_flags()` drops 1; with an AI seller, the AI's answer (`ai_respond_to_bid`: push 1; push slot, ret 8) and, if the offer is active, the empty exchange is freed and end. At the end of the list, the empty exchange is freed. 
 - Human manager: the contract talks news (`post_contract_talks_news`); the offer rescheduled for the next slice (`schedule_offer`: push 1; push 0); with an exchange and an AI seller, each exchange player's entry in the seller's list (`exe::shortlist_manager_find_club_shortlist_entry` with 0, 0) receives the offer's index `slot_index()` in `shortlist_slot::OFFER_REF`.

Sends news 0xfa0 of an offer made (target, clubs, values, exchange, contract, window) to the interested human managers. Ret 4; SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path (the local news item and date): `TRANSFER_MANAGER::post_offer_made_news(offer)`. The seller is the club of the target's contract (except type 5). The recipients (`exe::transfer_manager_collect_offer_news_recipients`: push 0x1e; push &vector; push 0x3e; push offer; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0x10); none: nothing. News 0xfa0 (`construct_news_item`: push 0; push 0xfa0; lea ecx, news, ret 8; the data through `set_news_field`: push v; push k; lea ecx, news, ret 8): 0 the target's id, 1..3 the `names::ID` of his `first_name()`/`second_name()`/`common_name()`, 4 the buyer (`buyer_club_id()`), 5 the seller's id (−1 if none), 6 `slot_index()`, 7 `serial()`, 8 `fee()`, 9 the status, 0xa the value (`exe::transfer_offer_get_total_value`: push 1; push 0; push 1; push 0; mov ecx, offer -> thiscall(offer, 0, 1, 0, 1), ret 0x10), 0xb `pre_contract()`, 0xe `offer_kind()` & 0xf. With `pre_contract()`, a seller and the target's role 11..15 (`job_for_club()`; `exe::database_is_player_job`, cdecl): through the target's contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`, without storing into `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`) its date (`contract_expires()`/`contract_expires_year()`) if it has not arrived yet (otherwise 0, 0) in 0xc/0xd and the type (`contract_type()`, 6 signed bits) in 0xf; without a contract, 0, 0, 0. Each exchange player (`exchange_players()`): the first 3 give the id and the 3 `names::ID` values starting at 0x18; 0x17 the count. The current person (the last of the exchange, or the target) with a national side (`national_job()`) that is a second team (`exe::club_is_national_team`, cdecl): 0x11 its id and flag 1; otherwise −1. The record (`offer_breaks_fee_record`: push 1; push offer; mov ecx, `G_CLUB_RECORDS` -> thiscall, ret 8) adds flag 2: 0x10 the flag; the next free index receives `job_type()`. The news to each recipient (`send_to_club_manager`: push club; push &news; mov ecx, `G_NEWS` -> thiscall, ret 8). With `pre_contract()`: `completion_timing()` & 0xf = 5, the fixed `exe::transfer_manager_get_next_window_dates` (stdcall(&date, 0): ecx is not read) gives 0x12 = 0 if today is the date, otherwise 5, and the date in 0xc/0xd; otherwise 0x12 = 3.

Tells whether the club can take the player on loan: current club, contract record, playing role, whether the club can reach him, the rule of the club's nation and of the current club month by month over the loan period; the reason text in the message. Ret 0xc; SEH frame without a destructor (the local date and texts): `TRANSFER_MANAGER::can_loan_player(club, player, msg)`, 1 can and 0 cannot. The current club is that of the player's contract (0x4cf5a0, in `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`; except type 5); the default local date (`exe::date_date_54a110`) and today's day of the month (`exe::date_get_day_of_month`: mov ecx, `G_CURRENT_DATE` -> thiscall, ret 0). No current club, or with a contract record (`exe::contract_manager_get_loan_contract`: push player; mov ecx, `G_CONTRACT_MANAGER`, ret 4): 0. Role (`job_for_club()`) other than `job_kind::PLAYER`: 0, with the name text (`database_format_staff_name`: push 1; push 0x12c; push text; push player; add esp, 0x10) in `[0xde1f64]` (`FN_LANGLIB_SPRINTF`, cdecl) if there is a message. If the club cannot reach the player (`can_club_bid_for_player`: push 0; push &reason; push club; push player; mov ecx, this, ret 0x10): 0 and, with a message, the text for the reason (0x21 the club of the agreed offer, `agreed_contract_offer`, or the current one, clearing bit 0x40 of the 8-byte record in `[[G_TRANSFER_MANAGER] + transfer_manager_fields::PERSON_FLAGS]` without an offer; 0x27, 7 and 1 in the message; 0x12/0x13; 0x19, 0x28 and 0x1a with the nation's adjective, `nation_get_nationality_adjective`: push 0xd; push 0x64; push text; push nation; add esp, 0x10). The rule of the club's nation (of the 28 at `transfer_manager_fields::TRANSFER_RULES`, the one whose `transfer_rules::NATION_ID` equals the club's `nation()`): virtual +0x20 (push 0; push message; push player; push club; mov ecx, rule) equal to 0 gives 0. The rule of the current club's nation: without it, 1. The loan period (`transfer_manager_get_loan_period`: push &end_year; push &end_month; push &start_year; push &start_month; push player; push contract club; push club; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0x1c): start equal to end gives 1. Otherwise the date (day of the month, start; `exe::date_set`: push −1; push year; push month; push day; lea ecx, date -> thiscall, ret 0x10) and virtual +0x24 (push 1; push &date; push 0; push player; push current club; mov ecx, rule) different from 0 gives 1; it advances one month (`exe::date_date_549f70`: push −1; push end_year; push end_month; push day; lea ecx, local -> thiscall, ret 0x10) while the end date is after the date, again `exe::date_set` and the virtual (different from 0 gives 1); once past: 0, with "This loan deal cannot go ahead" in the message.

Removes the player from the offer's part-exchange list (or from his other offers), his value goes to the price, the news, the computer seller's reply and the offer goes on. Ret 0x10; SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path (the local list): `TRANSFER_MANAGER::remove_exchange_player(person, offer, so_esta, reason)`, from the contract offer to the player (`offer_contract_to_offer_player`), the confirmation by the club (`confirm_offer_by_club`), the release of the offer's players (`detach_offer_players`) and the screen. Only this one (`so_esta`): without the exchange list (`offer::EXCHANGE_PLAYERS`), nothing; with the person in it (+0 of each item = id), he leaves (`exe::llist_remove`), his 8-byte record (`person_flags()` + id × 8, +2) loses an offer, the news (`exe::transfer_manager_post_exchange_player_removed_news` with the value = `value()` of the person + `offer::FEE` of the offer and the reason) and, with the owner of the target's contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`, except type 5) being the computer (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club`), its answer (`ai_respond_to_bid` with &offer and 1): a resolved offer (status 2, 3, 0x14, 0x10, 4, or 0xf with `offer::RESPONSE_ROUND` ≥ 3) only frees the empty list; otherwise the price (`offer::FEE`) becomes the value and the offer goes on (`advance_offer_to_club_approval`). At the end, the empty list is freed. Otherwise, with the person in some offer (+2 of the record): his offers by the club (`get_exchange_offers_for_player` into a local list), except this one; in each, he leaves the exchange list (the empty list is freed) and, from the first one that had him, the price becomes `value()` + the price, the news (reason 0) and the offer goes on.

Checks the offer's work permits: of the target at the buyer (refused: the offer collapses, status 0x10, rescheduled in 10 days, returns 0) and of each part-exchange player at the seller (refused: he leaves the exchange and his value goes to the price); the news and the offer goes on. Ret 8: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::check_offer_work_permits(offer, quiet)`, from the processing of the offer (status 0xa, 0x8c6880) and the completion (0x8cbc40). The owner of the target's contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`, `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`; any type). Target (`target_staff_id()`) with a permit to request at the buyer (`buyer_club_id()`) and a proposal, not granted (check_work_permit): the offer collapses (`post_offer_collapsed_news` with 0x13), status `offer_status::CANCELLED`, the proposals closed (`transfer_manager_close_offer_contract_offers`), the bid marks removed (`clear_bid_markers_for_player` on the list manager `shortlist_manager()`: the buyer and the target, then the owner of the target's contract and each exchange player), rescheduled in 10 days (`schedule_offer`) and returns 0. Granted (or no proposal) and without `quiet`: the grant news (`exe::transfer_manager_post_work_permit_granted_news`). Then, each exchange player (`exchange_players()`) at the owner of the target's contract: refused, the news (`exe::transfer_manager_post_exchange_player_permit_refused_news` with value `value()` + the price), he leaves the exchange (`exe::llist_remove`), his 8-byte record loses an offer and the price (`fee()`) becomes the value; granted without `quiet`, the news. The empty list is freed; without `quiet`, the offer goes on (`advance_offer_to_club_approval`). Returns 1.

One slice of the transfer day: window notices, overdue offers rescheduled, the slice's bucket processed; in slice 2 the base date moves to tomorrow, instalments at month end, nation rules; on day 100 the +0x1e of non-EU persons at the club for years. Ret 8; SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path (the local dates): `TRANSFER_MANAGER::daily_update(today, slice)`. Without a base date (year `transfer_manager_fields::CURRENT_YEAR` zeroed), it becomes today (`exe::date_operator_3d`: push today; push out; lea ecx, `[this + transfer_manager_fields::CURRENT_DATE]` -> thiscall, ret 8) and slice `transfer_manager_fields::CURRENT_SLICE` today's. Only with today equal to the base and the slice equal to `transfer_manager_fields::CURRENT_SLICE`: in slice 0 the window notices (`update_transfer_window_news`: push today; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 4); on a day that is a multiple of 7, each overdue offer (date `offer::DUE_DATE`/`offer::DUE_YEAR` before today; status `offer::STATUS` not 0x13, 7, 8 or 0xa) is rescheduled for tomorrow (`schedule_offer` with 1 day); slice `transfer_manager_fields::CURRENT_SLICE` goes up 1; the free transfer queue (`process_free_transfer_queue`: mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0); the current bucket (0xe-byte lists at this+0x18 + 0xe·(3·`transfer_manager_fields::DAY_CURSOR` + slice), cursor at the start): each valid index of vector `[this]` (count `transfer_manager_fields::OFFER_CAPACITY`) with today's offer and of this slice (`offer::DUE_SLICE`) is processed (`process_due_offer`: push slot; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 4); the bucket is emptied (`exe::llist_clear`). In slice 2: the base becomes tomorrow (`exe::date_add_days` push 1; push out; mov ecx, base -> thiscall, ret 8 and `exe::date_operator_3d`), `transfer_manager_fields::CURRENT_SLICE` goes back to 0, `transfer_manager_fields::DAY_CURSOR` goes up (from 49 back to 0); when the month changes from today to tomorrow (`exe::date_get_month`: mov ecx, date -> thiscall, ret 0), the instalments (`pay_transfer_instalments`); on day 0, the old transfers to the archives (`exe::transfer_manager_clear_old_past_transfers`) and the work permits (`update_work_permits`); virtual +0 of each of the 28 nation rules (`[this + transfer_manager_fields::TRANSFER_RULES]`, push today; mov ecx, rules); on a day that is a multiple of 7, the permits again. In slice 0 (other than slice 2), the future transfers (`process_due_future_transfers`). On day 100 of slice 2: the day-100 dates of 5, 2 and 10 years ago (`exe::new_date`: push year; push 0x64; lea ecx, local -> thiscall, ret 8) and, for each person (0x6e-byte records in `G_STAFF_TABLE`, count `G_STAFF_COUNT`, reread) with date +0x3e/+0x40 before the 2-year one, a club (`[[staff::CLUB_JOB] + club::NATION]`) in a nation (`[+0x71]`) with id `KEY_CONTINENT_EUROPE` and not EU-eligible there (`database_is_staff_eu_national`: push club; push person; add esp, 8 -> cdecl): `staff::SECOND_NATION` (the second nationality) = the club's nation (`club::NATION`), if it is `KEY_NATION_SPAIN` or `KEY_NATION_PORTUGAL`; if the date is before the 5-year one and it is not `KEY_NATION_ITALY`, `KEY_NATION_FINLAND` or `KEY_NATION_RUSSIA`; or if the date is before the 10-year one.

Dispatches the offer due today by its status: seller response, acceptance, player contract, permits, completion, removal or a new round of the offer. Ret 4; SEH frame (the local lists, built by `exe::new_llist` and destroyed by `exe::drop_llist` in the same order): `TRANSFER_MANAGER::process_due_offer(slot)`, the offer that falls due today, by status `status()`. The seller is the club of the target's contract (`target_staff_id()`; except type 5), the buyer `buyer_club_id()`. 
 - 0: without a seller, the bid acceptance (`accept_transfer_bid`: push 0; push slot -> thiscall, ret 8). Human seller: status 4, 14 days (`schedule_offer`) and the bids unmarked (clear_offer_bid_markers). Otherwise, without flag `offer::OFFER_TYPE` = 1, the AI's answer (`ai_respond_to_bid`: push 0; push slot, ret 8); with it, the seller's prediction (`shortlist_manager_predict_selling_club_response`, stdcall(seller, target, 0 i64, buyer, −1 i64, 1): ecx = `shortlist_manager()` is not read): refusal, the loan refusal (`reject_loan_offer`: push 0; push 0; push slot -> thiscall, ret 0xc); accepted, the decision (`schedule_decision_for_transfer`: push offer; mov ecx, `G_CONTRACT_MANAGER` -> thiscall, ret 4), status 8 and the acceptance news (`post_offer_accepted_news`: push offer, ret 4); with the decision, the refusal-to-move news (`post_player_rejects_move_news`: push 0; push offer, ret 8), status 0xf, `offer::RESPONSE_ROUND` = 3, the bids unmarked, 10 days, and if the offer and those of the list at +0 are closed (`transfer_offer_closed`, stdcall(offer)), bit 0 of the target's 8-byte record in `person_flags()` is cleared. 
 - 2, 3, 4, 0xf, 0x10, 0x14: with 0xf and `response_round()` < 3, `offer::RESPONSE_ROUND` = 3 and 10 days; otherwise the offer is removed (`remove_offer`: push offer, ret 4). 
 - 1: human buyer: status 4, the bids unmarked and 10 days; otherwise `exe::transfer_manager_submit_loan_contract_offer` (push slot, ret 4) with `offer::OFFER_TYPE` = 1 or `exe::transfer_manager_review_ai_club_bid` (push 0; push slot, ret 8). 
 - 5, 6: human buyer: status 9 and 10 days; otherwise the contract to the target (`offer_contract_to_offer_player`: push offer; push target; push buyer, ret 0xc). 
 - 7 with an exchange (`exchange_players()`): human seller: status 8 and 10 days; otherwise, on a copy of the list (`exe::llist_copy_from`: push list; lea ecx, local, ret 4), the contract to each exchange player until the offer becomes active. 
 - 0xa: the permits (`check_offer_work_permits`: push 0; push offer, ret 8). 0xe: the completion (`try_complete_offer`: push 0; push offer, ret 8). 
 - 0x11, 0x12: status 0; with `terms_state()`, the offer passes to the clubs (`advance_offer_to_club_approval`: push offer, ret 4); otherwise, with a human manager at the contract club (`news_club_has_human_manager`, stdcall(club): ecx = `G_NEWS` is not read), the offer-made news (`post_offer_made_news`: push offer, ret 4) and 28 days; otherwise the offer value (`exe::transfer_offer_get_weighted_value`: mov ecx, offer -> thiscall(offer, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1), ret 0x14) and the seller's prediction (seller, target, value, buyer, −1, 0): 0 accepts (`accept_transfer_bid`), 1 or 2 refuses (`reject_transfer_offer`: push 0; push 0; push slot, ret 0xc).

Checks an offer's restrictions: completion date, board veto, budget (1.1 times, plus the shortlist offers), squad room and the nation rule; 0 allows, 1 or 2 block. Ret 0x10; SEH frame (the local date and list, the list built by `exe::new_llist` and destroyed by `exe::drop_llist`): `TRANSFER_MANAGER::check_offer_restrictions(o, decides, reason, without_squad)`; 0 allows, 1 or 2 block. The buyer is `buyer_club_id()`, the target `target_staff_id()` and the seller the club of his contract (except type 5). 
 - With `completion_timing()` & 0xf and status not `offer_status::FUTURE_TRANSFER`: the completion date (`transfer_manager_get_offer_completion_date`: push &date; push offer, ret 8) goes into the reason; a reason different from 0 gives 2; today before the date gives 0. 
 - Without `without_squad`, a target with a player sheet (`player()`) and type 11..15 in `job_type()` (`exe::database_is_player_job`, cdecl of the byte): the decider is the seller with `pre_contract()` = 0 and the seller not obliged to accept (`transfer_manager_selling_club_must_accept`, stdcall(offer, 0, 0)), or the decider is the buyer: the veto (`check_board_veto`: push reason; push decider; push target; push seller; push buyer; push offer, ret 0x18) gives 2. 
 - The buyer's budget (`get_club_finance`: push buyer; mov ecx, `G_FINANCE_TABLE`, ret 4; `exe::finance_get_transfer_budget`: push 0 ×4; push target; mov ecx, finances, ret 0x14, returns i64; negative becomes 0) rounded to the next step (`exe::cash_step_up`: push 4; lea ecx, &money, ret 4) and the offer value (`exe::transfer_offer_get_total_value`: mov ecx, offer -> thiscall(offer, 0, 1, 1, 0), ret 0x10). The decider is the buyer: value > budget × 1.1: reason 3; a human buyer gives 1; otherwise the budget plus the `fee()` of the buyer's offers (`find_club_offer_for_player`: push 0; push buyer; push person, ret 0xc) for the players on his scouting list (`collect_club_shortlist_entries`: push &list; push buyer; mov ecx, `shortlist_manager()`, ret 8) exceeding the value gives 1, otherwise 2. Within budget, no room in the squad (`check_squad_limits`: push reason; push without_squad; push offer; push club, ret 0x10) gives 1. 
 - The decider is the seller: no room in his squad gives 1. Reason 0. With an exchange (`exchange_players()`) or type 11..15: the rule of the decider's nation (`[this + transfer_manager_fields::TRANSFER_RULES]`, the one whose `transfer_rules::NATION_ID` equals the decider's `nation()`): virtual `transfer_rules_vtable::CAN_MAKE_OFFER` (push reason; push `G_CURRENT_DATE`; push decider; push offer; mov ecx, rule) different from 0 gives 0; reason 9 with `completion_timing()` & 0xf = 5 gives 0; otherwise 2. No rule: 0.

Pays former clubs their fee cuts: for a player over 22, (offer fee / 20) / sum of weights × the weight of each of up to five former clubs goes into the buyer's sales; news 0xfc3 goes to the former club when the cut exceeds 11 × reputation − 10000. Ret 4; SEH frame without a destructor; this is not used: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::pay_former_club_fee_cuts(o)`, from a completed transfer with a fee (`fee()`) of a player without +0x69 (`finalise_transfer`). A player (`target_staff_id()` of the offer) over 22 years old (`age()`): news 0xfc3 (local; 0 = id, 1..3 = the `names::ID` of `first_name()`/`second_name()`/`common_name()`, 4 = the buyer `buyer_club_id()`, 7 = the contract club or −1); the sum (16 bits) of the weights (byte `staff_state::FORMER_CLUB_WEIGHT`) of the five former-club slots of the 79-byte record (`G_STAFF_STATE_TABLE`, step 5, club at `staff_state::FORMER_CLUB_ID`, −1 = empty slot; a sum of 0 becomes 1). Each slot with a club: ((fee / 20) / sum) × weight (a weight below 1 counts as 1) goes into the sales of the BUYER's finances (`european_cup_club_finance` with `buyer_club_id()`, `add_players_sold`; this is what the original does); above 11 × reputation (`reputation()`) − 10000 of the slot's club, the news with 5 = the amount and 6 = the club id goes to its manager.

Pays the next-sale percentage: binary-searches the person's clause with the contract club; the cut (percentage × offer fee plus exchange players, or the person's value) from 1000 up: news, transfer totals, paid into the clause club and out of the contract club. Ret 8: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::pay_next_sale_percentage(p, o)`, from a completed transfer with the person's flag 8 (`settle_previous_transfer_clauses`). With a contract (and a contract club), looks by binary search (`exe::crt_bsearch`, 0xd-byte entries in `next_sale_percentages()`, count `next_sale_percentage_count()`, comparison 0x8e54d0) for the clause with +1 = contract club id and +9 = person id. Found: the base is the offer fee (`fee()`) plus the value (`staff::VALUE`) of each exchange player (`exchange_players()`, LLIST of ids, cursor restarted) when the person is the offer's one (`target_staff_id()`); otherwise the person's value for the contract club (`calc_player_value` with 0, −1, 0). The cut = percentage (byte +0, signed) × base / 100; from 1000 up: the news (`post_sale_percentage_news`, with 1 if it was the offer's person), the club's transfer totals (`add_transfer_totals` on `G_CLUB_RECORDS`: the cut, the contract club, the clause club `sell_on_clause::RECEIVING_CLUB_ID`), the cut goes into the clause club's sales and out through the contract club's purchases. The clause stays (`remove_next_sale_percentage` is what removes it).

Sends news 0xfa7: the person, the percentage, the two clause clubs, the cut and the buyer (or the contract club), to the managers of the clause club and the seller. Ret 0x10; SEH frame without a destructor; this is not used: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::post_sale_percentage_news(e, part, o, of_offer)`, from the percentage paid (`pay_next_sale_percentage`). News 0xfa7 (local): 0..3 the clause's person (`sell_on_clause::PERSON_ID`: id and the `names::ID` of `first_name()`/`second_name()`/`common_name()`), 4 = the percentage (byte +0), 5 = the clause club (`sell_on_clause::RECEIVING_CLUB_ID`), 6 = the selling club (`sell_on_clause::PAYING_CLUB_ID`), 7 = the cut, 8 = `of_offer`, 9 = the buyer (`buyer_club_id()` of the offer) with `of_offer`; otherwise the id of the contract club (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`; without a contract or without a club: ends without delivering). Goes to the managers of the clause club and of the seller (`send_to_club_manager`).

Decides the work permit: by the permit record (matches and refusals), a non-player by reputation, the 2001 exceptions, potential above 8500, wage above 34999, youth above 190, under 5 caps no, over 20 with a strong nation yes, and the 16-match national side history (over 11 or 70%), which advances with new matches. Ret 0x14: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::is_work_permit_granted(p, _nation, offer, record, sorteio)`, from the permit in the scouting list (`passes_work_permit_check`, without offer, record or random), from the accepted contract offer (`complete_accepted_contract_offer`, with the offer) and from the offer's permits (`check_offer_work_permits`). The person's contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`, without writing `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`): of type 2 it is the "loan", otherwise the "contract". With the permit record (the given one, or found by binary search `exe::crt_bsearch` in `work_permits()`, count `work_permit_count()`, 14 bytes, when flag 0x20 exists): without an offer, granted if matches (`work_permit::MATCHES_PLAYED`) > 3 × refusals (`work_permit::MATCHES_MISSED`) or refusals < 4; with an offer, the same rule if the loan ends after the offer (`contract::CONTRACT_EXPIRES`) or the contract club is not the offer's (`contract::CLUB`), and granted if the loan does not end after. Non-player (`non_player()` without sheet `player()`): reputation (`world_reputation()`) above 160. In 2001, the two cases of Collin and Devon at Falkirk. Potential (`world_reputation()` of the sheet) above 8500 (with random: 8000 + random(1000)); offer wage (+0xc) above 34999; under 24 years with ability (`potential_ability()`) above 190: granted. Fewer than 5 caps (`int_apps()`): not granted; more than 20 with the nation's reputation (`reputation()`) above 3000 and under 32 years: granted. The history advances with the national side's new matches (`[[G_NATIONAL_TEAMS]+4]` + nation id × 0x6e + 2; each one pushes a zero bit) and the count stays. The window: 16 matches, or those of the two-year period (`count_results_in_period`, up to 16) from 2003; with more than 11 matches marked (random: 11 − random(3) + random(3)) or more than 70% (70 − random(10) + random(10)): granted.

Returns the squad status for the refusal reason (0x200: 1, 0x400: 2, 0x2000: 5) or that of the contract with the club (`squad_status()` >> 4); no contract, 0. Ret 8; this is not used: `transfer_manager_get_squad_status_for_reason(p, reason)`, from the offer screen. The person's contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`, stored in `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`) gives the club; the contract with it (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract_for_club`); without it, 0. The reason (signed 16 bits) 0x200 gives 1, 0x400 gives 2, 0x2000 gives 5; the others, the contract status (`squad_status()` >> 4). Returns in al.

Returns the address of slot i of the negotiation array; out of range, the start of the array. Ret 4: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::get_negotiation_slot(i)`, from the automatic reply to news items (0x782f70) and from the screens: the address of slot `i` of the negotiation vector (`negotiations()`, count `negotiation_capacity()`, signed); outside the count, the start of the vector.

The club rejects the loan offer: state 2, the bids unmarked, the news, the offer comes back in 10 days to be removed, the person's offer mark cleared with no open rival, the contract offers closed and the buyer's shortlist status. Ret 0xc: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::reject_loan_offer(slot, mark, reason)`, from the computer seller that refuses every loan bid (`ai_respond_to_bid`, offer with `offer_type()` = 1) and from the scheduled offer (`process_due_offer`). With `mark`, `player_aware` = 1; state 2 (`offer_status::REJECTED`) (refused) straight away; the person's contract goes into `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT` and gives the contract club; the buyer's bids for the player and those of the contract club for the exchange players are removed (`clear_bid_markers_for_player`); the news (`post_offer_rejected_news`); the offer comes back in 10 days (`schedule_offer`) to be removed; with no open rival, the person's offer mark is removed (`person_flags()`); the contract offers (`remove_contract_offer` and, through slot `slot_index()`, `remove_contract_offer_for_transfer` for each exchange player, whose mark +4 is zeroed), with +0x10 = 0 between them; finally the status in the buyer's scouting list (`exe::shortlist_manager_find_club_shortlist_entry`; found, `update_staff_status` with event 1 and type 0). It is the transfer refusal (`reject_transfer_offer`) without the unsettling, without the future transfer, without closing the linked contract offers and without the exchange players' part at the end: the `cpx1_*` helpers (with the dry run OFFER_RESPONSE_DRY_RUN) serve the same way.

Checks that the offer keeps the club (with its partner) within 50 players and the coach (5), physio (3), scout (7) and assistant slots; a computer buyer without an exchange releases for free the cheapest player who can leave; otherwise reason 4 or 0x22 (plus 1 for the seller) and 0. Ret 0x10; the map gives it as stdcall, but the two call sites in `check_offer_restrictions` put the manager in ecx and it uses it for `count_club_free_transfer_queue` and `free_transfer_staff`: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::check_squad_limits(club, offer, count_queue, reason)`, from the offer restrictions (`check_offer_restrictions`), for the buyer and for the seller. Null club: the box at line 0x2c3b and 0. The club's partner (`exe::club_get_linked_b_team` with 0 and 1). For the buyer (`buyer_club_id()` of the offer = club id): the offer's person already belongs to it (contract of type 5, again through `exe::contract_manager_get_contract`, with the club; or the loan record `contract_record` with +4 = the club) counts −1; a player by the offer's type `job_type()` counts +1; a staff type by the same byte marks 1; each exchange player (`exchange_players()`, LLIST of ids) who leaves is discounted (player −1, staff −1 by the person's `staff::JOB_FOR_CLUB`). For the seller: without an exchange, 1; the player sold counts −1 and the staff type −1 (by `staff::JOB_FOR_CLUB`); each incoming exchange node adds by byte +6. A positive count: adds the 50 of the squad (+0xd7, pointers with a live id) of the club and of the partner; above 50, minus the club's free queue (`count_club_free_transfer_queue`) if `count_queue`; still above 50: other than a computer buyer without an exchange, the reason (club ≠ buyer) + 4 and 0; otherwise the cheapest of the squad ((`contract::HAPPINESS` of the contract + 100) × value `staff::VALUE`, with `contract::HAPPINESS` ≤ 0, without a sheet, without a type 5 contract in `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`, without offers `get_offers_for_player`, exchanges `get_exchange_offers_for_player` or future transfer `get_future_transfer`, outside the free queue and not of type 0xb, 0xf or 0xd) leaves for free (`add_free_release_records` on `G_STAFF_RECORDS`, `free_transfer_staff` with −1); none, the reason + 4 and 0. Then the marked staff slots: 5 coaches (+0x19f), 3 physios (+0x1cf), 7 scouts (+0x1b3), those of the club counted by pointer and those of the partner only with a live id, and the assistant (`assistant_manager()` of the club or of the partner, occupied); over the limit, the reason + 0x22 and 0. Returns 1.

With the person's flag 8, binary-searches the person's next-sale percentage clause with the contract club; when not found, clears the flag. Ret 4: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::find_next_sale_percentage(p)`, from the person screens (0x884ea2): without the person's flag 8 (`person_flags()` + id × 8), 0. Her contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`, in `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`) and the club; without both, 0. The binary search (`exe::crt_bsearch`: cdecl(key, vector `next_sale_percentages()`, count `next_sale_percentage_count()`, 0xd, 0x8e54d0)) by the key with the club id (+1, again through the contract) and the person's (+9), the only two fields the comparison reads; found, returns the record; otherwise flag 8 is cleared and 0.

After the match, on both sides: pays the appearance money at 1, 10, 20... 50 games (club by contract, national side by caps since the deal) and removes the paid bonus; in a counting match, adds an appearance to the work permit of those who played and an absence to those left out without injury, ban, call-up or loan. Ret 8: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::update_appearance_clauses_after_match(game, fixture)`, from the end of each match (`close_day_match` and the simulated statistics 0x84be20). For both sides (+0x1c home, +0x20 away): the match counts for work permits with a competition (`competition()`) that is not a national side's (home side through `exe::database_is_national_team`) nor a friendly (`exe::friendly_is_friendly_competition`) and the side's byte (`fixture::HOME_SIDE_MARK` + side) set, or with +0 = −2. A club that is not a national side: the squad (`database_collect_club_squad`, 50 slots; national side: the vector stays as it was) and, when counting, its players with flag 0x20 (the 8-byte record at `person_flags()`). In the 20 match slots (`row_staff_id()` the id, `row_position()` ≠ −5, substitutes with `row_minute_on()` ≠ −1; without a player sheet `player()`, end of the slots): outside a loan (`exe::contract_manager_get_loan_contract`, only at the club) and with the clause flag (2 club, 4 national side), the matches (national side: `int_apps()` minus `person_transfer_record::INTERNATIONAL_APPS_AT_DEAL` of the record; club: `contract::CLUB_APPEARANCES` of the contract `exe::contract_manager_get_contract`) that are multiples of 10 up to 50, or 1, pay the bonus (`pay_appearance_money` with type 5 or 2) and, once paid, the bonus is removed (`remove_international_team_appearance_money` or `remove_first_team_appearance_money`). When counting, the marked player adds a match (+4 of the permit) and leaves the list; those remaining, without injury (`get_player_injury_status`), suspension (`is_player_suspended`), call-up (`get_international_duty_club`) or ineligibility (`get_ineligibility_code`), and not loaned by another club (`exe::contract_manager_get_loan_contract` with the contract stored in `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`), add an absence (+6).

Appends the international appearance money (13 bytes) to the array, growing by 50, and sorts it by person. Ret 4: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::add_international_team_appearance_money(record)`: appends the national side appearance bonus (13 bytes copied from `record`) to vector `international_appearance_money()` (capacity +0x89c, count `international_appearance_money_count()`); full, grows by 50 at a time (out of memory: box 0x25af and nothing). Sorts by person (qsort `exe::crt_qsort` with 0x8b4e00). The twin for the senior team is `add_first_team_appearance_money`.

Sends the 0xfa5 news of the agreed transfer, with the completion date, to the human seller and buyer. Ret 4; SEH frame for the local date and news item: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::post_transfer_finalised_news(o)`, from the agreed transfer (`advance_offer_to_club_approval`). The seller: the club of the person's contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`, stored in `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`) except type 5 (requested again, without storing). News 0xfa5: the person (the id and the three keys), the buyer, the seller (or −1), `slot_index()`, `serial()`, the fee `fee()`, the state `status()`, the total (`exe::transfer_offer_get_total_value` with 0, 1, 0, 1), `pre_contract()`, `job_type()`; the completion date (`transfer_manager_get_offer_completion_date`) after today goes in fields 0xe (day), 0xf (year) and 0xd (the low nibble of `completion_timing()`, signed), otherwise 0, 0, 0; the exchange count (`exchange_players()`) in 0xb. To the human seller (`news_club_has_human_manager`), outside state `offer_status::SELLER_CONFIRMED` and without a pending exchange (`pre_contract()` with nibble `completion_timing()`), and to the human buyer, each in field 0x10.

Records the free transfer and, unless record only, pays the club's compensation, removes the person from shortlists, selections, squad, offers and contract, clauses and work permit. Ret 0x14: `TRANSFER_MANAGER::free_transfer_staff(p, club, reason, compensation, so_record)`, from the free transfer queue (`process_free_transfer_queue`), from the end of contracts (0x4c7ac0) and from `check_squad_limits`. A person on loan (`exe::contract_manager_get_loan_contract`): nothing. The past transfer (0x25 bytes in vector `past_transfers()`, capacity +0x866, count `past_transfer_count()`; full, grows by 100 at a time; out of memory: box 0xce9 and nothing): `past_transfer::TO_CLUB_ID` −1, `past_transfer::FROM_CLUB_ID` the club or −1, today's date in `past_transfer::DATE`, the person (the id and the three keys), `past_transfer::MOVE_TYPE` 5 (record only) or 3, `past_transfer::FEE` 0. Record only: done.
